短题: 底线不是操作剧本
条文: {{规矩总件}}只定边界、权责与底线，不当操作剧本；长期边界与本次要求分清，可同件标记。做法自选，易变做法不升长期规矩，不自加审批或交付关卡。
为什么: 规矩控制边界，不是创造力的枷锁；应靠纠错成长，不靠层层加闸。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Rules define limits, not scripts
text: {{规矩总件}} defines limits, responsibilities, and minimum safeguards, not an operating script. Distinguish enduring limits from current requirements, marking them in the same document if useful. Choose methods locally; do not promote volatile methods into permanent rules or add approval and delivery checkpoints.
rationale: Rules limit authority without limiting creativity; improve through correction rather than accumulating checks.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 四类红线外先做后报
条文: 仅钱、不可逆、密钥与安全、{{决策者}}取向与审美先问；不可逆含永久删除、对外发布、修改{{规矩总件}}。其余本次授权内可回退事项先做后报，错了打回不追责；在{{留痕处}}记事项与回退办法，不另加审批。钱指项目自己花钱(买服务、付费接口、对外付款),产品里的收费功能是需求;对外发布指面向公众的发布与上架,以{{决策者}}名义向平台方发申请不算。
为什么: 能自行决定的先做，做后汇报，有问题再改，不每件事等点头。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Act and report outside four exceptions
text: Ask first only about money, irreversible actions, secrets and safety, and {{决策者}}'s direction or aesthetics. Irreversible actions include permanent deletion, public release, and changes to {{规矩总件}}. Within current authorization, perform other reversible actions and report afterward; corrections are not grounds for blame. Record the action and reversal in {{留痕处}} without another approval step. Money means spending by the project itself (buying services, paid APIs, or external payments); charging features within the product are requirements. Public release means publication and listing for the public, not submitting applications to platform operators on behalf of {{决策者}}.
rationale: Act independently where authorized, report afterward, and correct problems rather than waiting for permission on every action.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 小项目直接更新底线
条文: 小规模时，修改{{规矩总件}}须{{决策者}}明确决定；负责窗更新正文、版本与日期，沿用原入口，不另设修订传递流程。
为什么: 少窗直接更新现行入口即可；源项目经验。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Update small-project safeguards directly
text: At small scale, changes to {{规矩总件}} require an explicit decision by {{决策者}}. The responsible window updates its text, version, and date through the existing entry, without a separate amendment relay.
rationale: A few windows can update the current entry directly; this reflects experience in the source project.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 底线修订统一落笔同步
条文: 修改{{规矩总件}}须{{决策者}}明定，{{总协调}}落笔，更新版本、日期，同步全部现用入口指针。
为什么: 防止多处修订后入口仍指旧版(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Synchronize safeguard amendments
text: Changes to {{规矩总件}} require an explicit decision by {{决策者}}. {{总协调}} writes the amendment, updates its version and date, and synchronizes all active entry pointers.
rationale: Prevent entry pointers from referring to obsolete versions after amendments, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 分清外传与发行限制
条文: 明示禁外传的代码、素材、凭证、私有资料不得外传；明示禁发行的内容不入对外{{成品}}，混入即交付失败。
为什么: 防止禁外传或禁发行内容混出边界(源项目经验)
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Separate disclosure and distribution limits
text: Never disclose code, assets, credentials, or private materials explicitly marked confidential. Exclude content explicitly barred from distribution from the public {{成品}}; including it is a delivery failure.
rationale: Prevent confidential or distribution-restricted content from crossing its permitted limits, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 旧件先移走不永久删
条文: 区分在用与停用文件；不用的工作副本、临时件、旧产物、素材移待删或退役目录，{{留痕处}}记原、新位置。永久删除由{{决策者}}亲手做。
为什么: 旧件先集中待删，再由本人决定真删，不能把回收直接做成永久丢失。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Move obsolete files before deletion
text: Distinguish active from inactive files. Move unused working copies, temporary files, old outputs, and assets into pending-deletion or retired directories, recording old and new locations in {{留痕处}}. {{决策者}} performs permanent deletion personally.
rationale: Collect obsolete files first and let their owner decide whether to delete them permanently; collection must not itself destroy them.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 凭证只入专用保密记录
条文: 口令与令牌只存专用保密记录，不进聊天、任务书、回执、普通文书、命令行、日志或版本仓。
为什么: 普通留痕不能成为凭证扩散渠道；源项目经验。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Keep credentials in protected storage
text: Store passwords and tokens only in dedicated protected records, never in chat, assignments, receipts, ordinary documents, command lines, logs, or version repositories.
rationale: Ordinary records must not become channels for spreading credentials; this reflects experience in the source project.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 只回收自己启动的进程
条文: 自己启动的后台进程记编号；停子代理或收窗前，只按记录回收自己所起进程，不按名称终止整机同名进程。
为什么: 既回收孤儿进程，也不误杀其他工作。
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Stop only processes you started
text: Record identifiers of background processes you start. Before stopping helpers or closing a window, reclaim only processes identified in your own records; never terminate all same-named processes on the machine.
rationale: Reclaim orphaned processes without terminating other work.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 面向决策者讲中文人话
条文: 面向{{决策者}}用中文人话，不拿黑话代解释；文件名、提示词用中文，英文只留内部件与代码。
为什么: 接收者须看得懂，不是执行者自觉说全即可。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Use plain Chinese with the decision maker
text: Address {{决策者}} in plain Chinese, explaining rather than substituting jargon. Use Chinese filenames and prompts, reserving English for internal artifacts and code.
rationale: The recipient must understand the message; the sender's belief that it is complete is insufficient.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 需求归决策做法归执行
条文: {{决策者}}唯一决定需求、取向与审美并终局裁决；执行者在授权内对标当下顶尖通行做法自定方案。其做法建议非指令，有专业依据可说明并拒绝；看过仍坚持则照办记原话。
为什么: 希望执行者给专业依据，不把每条做法建议固化为硬要求。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Separate requirements from methods
text: {{决策者}} alone decides requirements, direction, aesthetics, and final disputes. Executors choose methods within their authorization using current leading practice. Method suggestions from the decision maker are not commands: explain and decline with professional grounds, but follow and record the original wording if the decision maker insists after reviewing them.
rationale: Provide professional evidence without turning every method suggestion into a permanent requirement.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 明确决定当窗生效
条文: {{决策者}}在任一对话线或窗口的明确决定即时有效，不以再建任务、归档或确认为前提。
为什么: 防止明确决定被额外手续延迟生效(源项目经验)
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Explicit decisions take effect immediately
text: An explicit decision by {{决策者}} in any conversation or window takes effect immediately, without requiring a new task, archive entry, or confirmation first.
rationale: Prevent extra procedures from delaying explicit decisions, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 原话逐字留底转写回指
条文: {{决策者}}原话带时刻、记录窗和稳定标识逐字追加，不覆盖，保留原图；原话与理解分列，转写词句、表值逐条回指原件，不编决定。既有决定查记录答复，一个记录件即可，不必建系统。
为什么: 原话是依据；咨询不等于决议，后来的理解不能覆盖原句，引用不能失联。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Preserve original wording and references
text: Append {{决策者}}'s original wording verbatim with its time, recording window, and stable identifier; never overwrite it and retain original images. Separate wording from interpretation, and trace transcribed statements and table values to their originals without inventing decisions. Answer questions about existing decisions from records; one record file suffices without building a system.
rationale: Original wording is evidence. Consultation is not a decision, later interpretation must not overwrite it, and references must remain traceable.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 请答讲清推荐不越权
条文: 请答每次≤5题，讲清选项后果与推荐；取向题和自主假设分列，不越权定取向。授权内技术取舍自定，注明已做与改回办法；无关工作照交付。决定记{{留痕处}}，咨询假设不当决定。
为什么: 问题须让人看懂；咨询和假设不能冒充已定取向。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Explain questions without exceeding authority
text: Ask at most five questions per exchange, explaining consequences and a recommendation. Separate direction questions from autonomous assumptions and never decide direction without authority. Make authorized technical choices yourself, stating what was done and how to reverse it; deliver unrelated work normally. Record decisions in {{留痕处}}, not consultation assumptions as decisions.
rationale: Questions must be understandable; consultations and assumptions must not masquerade as settled direction.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 查据后再判有无决定
条文: 报{{决策者}}已定须回查原话；报未定先查全已登记{{真源件}}与相关任务。无原话记存疑，非红线可回退项依通行做法或推荐先做。
为什么: 防止漏查就报未定或无原话却报已定(源项目经验)
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Check evidence before claiming a decision
text: Before reporting that {{决策者}} decided something, check the original wording. Before reporting no decision, inspect all registered {{真源件}} and related tasks. Mark unsupported decisions uncertain; for reversible actions outside the exceptions, follow common practice or the recommendation and report afterward.
rationale: Prevent declaring a decision absent after an incomplete search, or settled without original wording, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 待答取向分列原样转交
条文: 取向题逐项列选项及已授权默认做法，与自主假设分列，由{{总协调}}原样转交{{决策者}}；不依赖答复的工作照常收口，答后调整，不把未授权取向当已定。
为什么: 防止取向题混入假设或无关工作等答(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Forward unanswered direction questions unchanged
text: List direction questions individually with options and authorized defaults, separately from autonomous assumptions. {{总协调}} forwards them unchanged to {{决策者}}. Finish work that does not depend on the answer and adjust afterward; never treat unauthorized direction as decided.
rationale: Prevent mixing direction questions with assumptions or making unrelated work wait, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 数值单源且改数联动
条文: 同一规则或数值只设一份权威{{真源件}}，其他实现、表与历史档案不另立口径；文档引用不手抄，必须复述时登记来源，改数方同步受影响表述。
为什么: 文案会复述数值，改数后若不同步，表述便与实际脱节；改数方须连同受影响表述一起负责。
加回条件: 统一维护≥1组规则或数值时加回。
title: Maintain one authoritative value
text: Keep one authoritative {{真源件}} for each rule or value; implementations, tables, and historical archives do not establish separate definitions. Link documentation instead of copying values. When restatement is necessary, register its source; whoever changes a value synchronizes affected statements.
rationale: Repeated values drift after changes unless the changing party also owns affected statements.
restore_condition: Restore when centrally maintaining at least one set of rules or values.

短题: 实现终值与表述同改
条文: 规则或数值已约定由现行实现给出终值时，表与文案以实现为准；{{决策者}}裁定变更后，实现、表与文案同笔对齐，发现不符就修正派生表述，不另立终值。
为什么: 实现已换而表与文案仍引用旧值，会使同一事项出现冲突终值。
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓且统一维护≥1组规则或数值时加回。
title: Change implementation and descriptions together
text: When the current implementation is designated to determine a rule's final value, tables and descriptions follow it. After {{决策者}} approves a change, align implementation, tables, and descriptions in the same change. Correct inconsistent derived descriptions rather than introducing another final value.
rationale: Changing implementation while retaining old values in tables and descriptions creates conflicting answers.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository and centrally maintaining at least one set of rules or values.

短题: 共用要求只维护一份
条文: 共同要求只在{{作业件}}维护，各分工只补特有职责，不另造一套。冲突先依{{规矩总件}}，再依{{作业件}}；分工说明不得推翻共同要求。
为什么: 防止各位复抄共用要求后各自过期(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Maintain shared requirements once
text: Maintain shared requirements only in {{作业件}}; each role adds only its particular responsibilities rather than another set of shared rules. Resolve conflicts first through {{规矩总件}}, then {{作业件}}; role descriptions cannot override shared requirements.
rationale: Prevent copied shared requirements from expiring independently, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 按本次交付对象核实成果
条文: 只交{{决策者}}审稿时，核稿件可打开且齐全，不必先发布；向{{受众}}交{{成品}}时，核其能从约定入口取得、使用。报已保存前核文件存在且非空，清单、口头声明不代实物检查。
为什么: 清单与在用标签不能证明实际交付，写入提示也不能证明文件已写成。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Verify the actual delivery target
text: When delivering only a draft to {{决策者}}, check that it opens and is complete; publication is not required first. When delivering {{成品}} to {{受众}}, check acquisition and use through the agreed entry. Before claiming a file was saved, verify it exists and is nonempty; inventories and verbal claims do not replace inspection.
rationale: Lists and active labels do not establish actual delivery, and a write notification alone does not establish a saved file.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 先查已有资源再报缺
条文: 交付资源报缺前先查已有库；仍缺报{{决策者}}，不用凑合替代品充{{成品}}。
为什么: 已有资源可能尚未查到，不能未查就报缺或凑合
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Check existing resources before reporting gaps
text: Before reporting a missing delivery resource, inspect existing libraries. If it remains missing, report to {{决策者}} rather than presenting an inadequate substitute as {{成品}}.
rationale: An existing resource may simply not have been found; do not report absence before checking or substitute an inadequate item.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 协作进度只维护一份
条文: 数量、进度和完成要求只在{{留痕处}}维护，以实际交付为据；别处只给位置，不复抄。仅程序需读取时用结构化格式，历史不当当前进度。
为什么: 防止多处进度互相矛盾或历史冒充现状(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Keep collaboration progress in one place
text: Maintain quantities, progress, and completion requirements only in {{留痕处}}, based on actual delivery. Elsewhere provide locations rather than copies. Use structured data only when software must read it; history is not current progress.
rationale: Prevent contradictory progress copies or historical records being presented as current state, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 代码交付说明接入面
条文: 代码交付须约定测试全绿，并说明{{受众}}可感知面的接入点；无可感知面须明确声明。纯内部任务以完成合并为终态。
为什么: 防止代码虽通过测试却未接入使用(源项目经验)
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Explain product integration at code delivery
text: Code delivery requires the agreed tests to pass and identifies integration into behavior perceptible to {{受众}}. Explicitly state when no such behavior exists. Purely internal tasks finish at merge.
rationale: Prevent tested code from being delivered without integration into actual use, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 派遣先说明实际承接处
条文: 派任务前，说清产物在{{成品}}的真实使用链上由谁读取或使用；说不清实际承接处，不派出任务。
为什么: 防止产物无人读取却被当作有效交付(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Identify the real consumer before assignment
text: Before assigning work, state who reads or uses the output on the actual {{成品}} delivery path. Do not assign a task whose real consumer cannot be identified.
rationale: Prevent unused outputs from being counted as effective delivery, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 约定转写完成才交付
条文: 已约定转写的原始表达，转成可供执行的{{真源件}}才算执行真源已交付；原始材料保留为据。
为什么: 防止未转写的原稿被当作执行真源(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Deliver the agreed transcription
text: When transcription is agreed, original expressions count as an executable {{真源件}} only after that transcription is complete. Retain the original materials as evidence.
rationale: Prevent an untranscribed draft from being treated as an executable authority, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 转抄差异按真源核实
条文: 任务书数值附可重复核法；起草发现出题与{{真源件}}不符，逐项回报，不擅改出题。执行中转抄差异按真源做，收口记差异，不另设停工前置。
为什么: 防止转抄误差代替真源或无故停车(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Resolve copying differences against authority
text: Assignments containing values include a repeatable verification method. When drafting reveals a mismatch between a question and {{真源件}}, report each item rather than changing the question. During execution follow the authoritative source for copying discrepancies, recording them at delivery without adding a work-stoppage prerequisite.
rationale: Prevent copying errors from replacing authoritative values or causing unnecessary stoppages, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 小项目简短说明交付
条文: 小规模时，负责窗核实后简报交付物与位置；仅有遗留、自主假设或接手操作时再写，不每次写改稿都填三问。助手可起草，负责窗仍核事实；记录格式错就补正，不冒充成果未达标。
为什么: 代笔不转移核实责任，手续问题不应额外阻工。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Keep small-project delivery reports short
text: At small scale, verify and briefly report the deliverable and its location. Add remaining work, autonomous assumptions, or takeover operations only when they exist; do not complete three questions after every edit. Helpers may draft, but the responsible window verifies facts. Correct record-format errors without representing them as failed outputs.
rationale: Delegating writing does not transfer verification responsibility, and procedural errors must not unnecessarily stop work.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 谁交付谁核实报告
条文: 报告可自写或请助手起草，交付负责人核文件、关键数字与实际结果；草稿不算已核。失败如实报，未取数写原因，无验收人不填已验收；必要说明、不确定处、自主假设再写明。
为什么: 起草完成不等于事实已核实，完成断言须对照真实产物；一次性代笔不能代替责任窗确认。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: The delivery owner verifies the report
text: Write reports yourself or delegate drafting, but the delivery owner checks files, key values, and actual results; drafts are not verified evidence. Report failures honestly and explain missing measurements. Do not claim acceptance without an accepting person; state necessary caveats, uncertainty, and autonomous assumptions.
rationale: Drafting is not fact verification; completion claims require actual outputs, not a one-off delegated draft.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 检索命中不等于真读取
条文: 扫盘区分注释命中与实际读取引用；登记项、资源根名依开工基点，不抄旧报告作现状。
为什么: 防止注释命中和旧报告冒充当前读取(源项目经验)
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Distinguish matches from actual reads
text: When surveying files, distinguish comment matches from actual reads and references. Registry entries and resource-root names follow the starting revision, not old reports presented as current facts.
rationale: Prevent comment matches and obsolete reports from substituting for current consumption, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 缺少记录不等于数量零
条文: 清单为空或分类尚未登记时，只能报告缺少记录，不得据此推定资产数量为零。
为什么: 空清单与尚未分类说明没有统计记录，不能据此断言没有资产。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Missing records do not mean zero assets
text: When an inventory is empty or classification is unregistered, report missing records only; do not infer that the asset count is zero.
rationale: An empty inventory or absent classification means no statistical record, not no assets.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 未定数值只占位
条文: 涉及规则或数值的新词条在占位阶段不填写数值，不把尚未确定的值写成正式内容。
为什么: 防止未定数值混成正式口径(源项目经验)
加回条件: 统一维护≥1组规则或数值时加回。
title: Leave unsettled values blank
text: When adding terms about rules or values, leave values blank during the placeholder stage; do not publish undecided values as formal content.
rationale: Prevent unsettled values from becoming official definitions, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when centrally maintaining at least one set of rules or values.

短题: 依据完成后再核说明
条文: 依赖规则编写的说明，等规则编写完成后再核对，不把仍在编写的规则当作已完成的核对依据。
为什么: 防止依据未定就核出过期说明(源项目经验)
加回条件: 统一维护≥1组规则或数值时加回。
title: Check descriptions after their authority is ready
text: Check descriptions derived from rules after the rules are complete; do not treat rules still being written as a completed checking authority.
rationale: Prevent checking descriptions against unsettled rules and producing obsolete statements, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when centrally maintaining at least one set of rules or values.

短题: 规则真源先裁定后实现
条文: 规则或数值的{{真源件}}发生变更，先由{{决策者}}拍板并记录裁定，再派遣实现任务。
为什么: 防止未经裁定的规则直接进入实现(源项目经验)
加回条件: 统一维护≥1组规则或数值时加回。
title: Approve rule changes before implementation
text: When {{真源件}} for rules or values changes, {{决策者}} first decides and records the ruling; implementation is assigned afterward.
rationale: Prevent implementation of rules before approval, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when centrally maintaining at least one set of rules or values.

短题: 共用子代理定义单源
条文: 共用子代理定义指定唯一的{{真源件}}；确需保留的副本随真源同步修改，并按约定方法核对，不能各自演变成另一套定义。
为什么: 防止共用定义多份修改后不一致(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Keep shared helper definitions authoritative
text: Designate one {{真源件}} for shared helper definitions. Synchronize necessary copies with it and verify them by the agreed method; copies cannot evolve into separate definitions.
rationale: Prevent shared definitions from diverging after independent edits, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 查资料先找相关位置
条文: 找资料、前文或设定，先在相关目录和文件中搜索，再读命中的段落；范围太大或搜索太久，就缩小范围，不从整个磁盘无边界查找。
为什么: 先缩小查找范围，避免为找一段资料持续占用大量内存和读盘资源。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Search relevant locations first
text: Find reference material, earlier text, or settings by searching relevant directories and files, then read matching passages. Narrow an overly broad or slow search rather than searching the entire disk without limits.
rationale: Narrow searches avoid sustained memory and disk use merely to locate a passage.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 大规模协作权责分层
条文: 大规模协作按{{决策者}}、{{总协调}}、位主分层,各层对相应改动面负责;位主窗即施工主窗,直派助手施工并整合交付,另开执行窗只按 G-0085 的条件增设,不设常设员工层;不把具体施工职责混作全局指挥权。
为什么: 防止具体施工职责混成全局指挥权(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Separate authority at large scale
text: Large collaborations distinguish {{决策者}}, {{总协调}}, and role owners; each owns its corresponding change area. A role owner's window is the construction window, directly assigning helpers and integrating delivery. Add a separate execution window only under G-0085; no permanent employee tier. Concrete execution responsibility is not global command authority.
rationale: Prevent execution responsibility from turning into global command authority, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 小项目一窗负责交付
条文: 小规模时，一项任务由一窗从输入到{{成品}}交全，配套一并做完；需子代理就直派并整合验收，不按环节设长期岗位或纯转述层。
为什么: 一次性工作多一层来回反而复杂，应由同一负责窗交付到底。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: One window delivers small tasks end to end
text: At small scale, one window owns a task from input through complete {{成品}}, including supporting work. If helpers are needed, assign directly and integrate acceptance; do not create lasting stage-specific roles or relay-only layers.
rationale: Another relay layer makes one-off work more complicated; one responsible window should deliver it completely.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 一项分工一人负责交全
条文: 同一分工同时明确一名负责人，交全成果与配套并协调协作者。换人交代已做、未做、下一步并更新职责记录；不因规模增加另设长期岗位。
为什么: 防止责任分散、配套漏交或换人断档(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: One owner completes each responsibility
text: Name one owner for each responsibility at a time. That owner delivers complete outputs and supporting work and coordinates contributors. On replacement, state completed work, remaining work, and next steps, and update responsibility records; scale growth alone does not justify permanent roles.
rationale: Prevent divided ownership, missing supporting work, and discontinuity during handover, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 总协调记账不审批
条文: {{总协调}}登记公共接口、落笔共享规矩与决定、协调方向，不审批；不在岗时，各位在既定边界内自定并在{{留痕处}}记一行，事后可调整。
为什么: 公共记账不是开工许可；不能因为协调者暂不在岗，就让职责内可以执行的工作等待审批。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: The coordinator records rather than approves
text: {{总协调}} registers shared interfaces, writes shared rules and decisions, and coordinates direction without approving work. When absent, each role decides within existing limits and records one line in {{留痕处}}; adjust afterward if necessary.
rationale: Shared bookkeeping is not permission to start; a coordinator's absence must not stop authorized work.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 公共协议按归属处理
条文: 分工位不得擅改公共协议；涉及修改时交由{{总协调}}或负责该协议的分工位处理。
为什么: 防止单方擅改公共协议破坏协作(源项目经验)
加回条件: 写程序时加回。
title: Respect shared protocol ownership
text: Roles must not change shared protocols without authority. Refer necessary changes to {{总协调}} or the role responsible for that protocol.
rationale: Prevent unilateral shared-protocol changes from breaking collaboration, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when programming starts.

短题: 同一领域裁定统一承接
条文: 同一事务领域由一个分工位统一承接{{决策者}}的决定，逐字记录并在{{留痕处}}留痕，再按影响面派遣；其他分工位不另立口径，涉及变更交所属分工位处理。
为什么: 同一领域的决定只需向一个对接方说一次，再由其记录和分发，不让决策者向多个分工位反复说明。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: One contact receives decisions per domain
text: One role receives {{决策者}}'s decisions for each domain, records original wording in {{留痕处}}, and assigns work according to impact. Other roles do not create separate definitions; send changes to the owning role.
rationale: A decision in one domain should be told once to a contact who records and distributes it, not repeated to every role.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 保管整理不取得裁定权
条文: 负责{{真源件}}、规矩或其库整理的分工位，只按已确认判定管理收录、去重、归档、时效、查询、导出与指针；入库或保管不转移修订权，不取得内容裁定、审查、监督权，仍由原授权方批准。
为什么: 防止保管真源被误当取得内容裁定权(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Custody does not grant decision authority
text: A role maintaining {{真源件}}, rules, or their database manages inclusion, deduplication, archival, validity, queries, exports, and pointers only according to confirmed rulings. Storage or custody does not transfer amendment rights or grant content, review, or supervision authority; original authorizers still approve.
rationale: Prevent custody of authoritative material from being mistaken for authority to decide its content, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 区分故障修复与新增
条文: 原应有而损坏的归故障修复，原无的能力归新增，按既定职责承接；跨位归属不清先直接对齐，谈不拢再交{{总协调}}。
为什么: 曾出现业务有交叉或冲突时，各窗不会自行沟通的情况；分清任务性质后，应先由相关分工位直接对齐。
加回条件: 写程序时加回。
title: Distinguish repairs from new capabilities
text: Repair restores something intended but broken; a new capability supplies something absent. Assign both through existing responsibilities. For unclear overlapping ownership, align directly first and involve {{总协调}} only if agreement fails.
rationale: Related windows previously failed to communicate about overlaps; identifying task type supports direct coordination first.
restore_condition: Restore when programming starts.

短题: 主窗保留协调与结论
条文: 主窗集中处理派遣、决策、成果整合与向{{决策者}}回报；大文件阅读和大量输出的命令交子代理，主窗接收可核对的结论，不重复承接整份原始输出。
为什么: 防止原始输出挤占主窗协调与决策(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Main windows retain coordination and conclusions
text: The main window concentrates on dispatch, decisions, integration, and reporting to {{决策者}}. Delegate large-file reading and high-output commands to helpers, receiving verifiable conclusions rather than duplicating all raw output.
rationale: Prevent raw output from crowding out main-window coordination and decisions, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 受限操作遵守授权入口
条文: 任务中明确限制执行人的操作，只由获授权的执行窗(若设)亲手从统一入口执行；不同取证目的不构成绕开执行权限或另起入口的理由。
为什么: 防止以取证目的绕开执行权限(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Use authorized entries for restricted operations
text: Operations explicitly restricted to particular executors must be performed personally by authorized execution windows, if any, through the unified entry. Different evidence-gathering purposes do not justify bypassing execution permissions or creating another entry.
rationale: Prevent evidence-gathering purposes from bypassing execution permissions, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 小项目追因超时说明
条文: 小规模时，同一失败追因达约定时限仍未定因，记录已确认失败与根因未定，报{{决策者}}；本次照约定交付，不无限追查。
为什么: 追因有时限，超时须如实说明，不无期限拖住本次交付；源项目经验。
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Time-box small-project diagnosis
text: At small scale, if diagnosis of one failure reaches its agreed time limit without a cause, record the confirmed failure and unknown cause and report to {{决策者}}. Deliver the task as agreed rather than investigating indefinitely.
rationale: Diagnosis needs a limit and an honest unresolved report rather than blocking delivery without end.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 失败追因超时移交
条文: 同一失败项追因达到约定时限仍未定因，记录已确认的失败事实与根因未定，交{{总协调}}安排接续；本次任务照约定交付，不持续追查。
为什么: 防止单项追因无期限拖住交付(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Hand over diagnosis at its time limit
text: When diagnosis of one failure reaches the agreed limit without a cause, record confirmed facts and the unknown cause and ask {{总协调}} to arrange continuation. Deliver the current task as agreed rather than continuing indefinitely.
rationale: Prevent one unbounded investigation from blocking delivery, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 素材制作与使用分清责任
条文: 若已把素材制作、整理和用于{{成品}}分给不同负责人，各自只维护约定负责的清单；新增素材后告知实际使用者，说明文件位置和用途。未获授权不改对方清单、成片或程序；一个人负责时不另设交接岗位。
为什么: 防止素材制作与使用分工互改漏交(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序，且有素材时加回。
title: Separate asset production and use responsibilities
text: If asset creation, organization, and use in {{成品}} have different owners, each maintains only the agreed inventory. Notify actual consumers of new assets with locations and purposes. Do not modify another owner's inventory, output video, or program without authorization; one person doing all work needs no handover role.
rationale: Prevent asset producers and consumers from overwriting each other's work or missing delivery, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts) and assets are involved.

短题: 临时换档不改共用定义
条文: 子代理类型与默认档位统一维护，分工位不各自新建或修改；临时换档只在本次派遣中明确覆盖，实际分配与常规不同则在{{留痕处}}记明，不改共用定义。
为什么: 防止临时换档污染共用默认定义(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Temporary tier changes do not alter defaults
text: Maintain helper types and default capability tiers centrally; individual roles do not create or modify them. State temporary overrides only in the current assignment, recording deviations in {{留痕处}} without changing shared defaults.
rationale: Prevent temporary tier overrides from contaminating shared defaults, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 进度和要求只记一处
条文: {{留痕处}}集中记任务、交付、决定、进度与阻塞，一个文件即可，别处不复抄。新要求记收到时刻，区分{{决策者}}要求与自定安排；告知催办直联相关人，不为一句话建任务。
为什么: 状态需要留底，协调不应多一道手续；现值复抄多处会失去唯一依据。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Record tasks and requirements once
text: {{留痕处}} holds tasks, deliveries, decisions, progress, and blockers centrally; one file suffices and other places do not copy it. Timestamp new requirements and distinguish {{决策者}}'s requirements from self-chosen arrangements. Notify relevant people directly instead of creating a task for a single message.
rationale: State needs a record, but coordination needs no extra procedure; copying current values destroys their single authority.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 状态留痕协调直达
条文: 需状态或答复的事项记{{留痕处}}并直告相关在岗窗，纯知会只留记录。每次只找一两个直接协作者，不群发、逐层转报或为一句话建任务；谈不拢再交{{总协调}}。
为什么: 曾有交叉冲突却不自行沟通，直联可免等待与转述失真
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Record state and coordinate directly
text: Record matters requiring status or a reply in {{留痕处}} and notify the relevant working window directly; informational messages need only a record. Contact one or two direct collaborators rather than broadcasting, relaying up hierarchies, or creating tasks for one sentence. Involve {{总协调}} only if agreement fails.
rationale: Direct contact avoids waiting and distorted relays when work overlaps or conflicts.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 员工只在经手任务留言
条文: 执行窗(若设)只在自己经手的任务记录下留言，不在无关任务记录中代行协调。
为什么: 防止员工在无关任务越权代协调(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Execution windows comment only on their tasks
text: Execution windows, if any, comment only on tasks they handle and do not coordinate through unrelated task records.
rationale: Prevent execution windows from coordinating unrelated tasks beyond their authority, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 协调入口固定维护有归属
条文: 每个分工位保留一条明确的协调对话线；通道本身的缺陷与需求，交维护该通道的责任方处理。
为什么: 防止协作无固定入口或通道故障无人管(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Maintain an owned coordination channel
text: Each role keeps one explicit coordination conversation. Send defects and requirements concerning the channel itself to the party maintaining it.
rationale: Prevent collaboration without a fixed entry or unowned channel failures, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 关键进度标时刻与基点
条文: 进度记录只写约定的关键节点，每段注明当前时刻与当时共享代码基线标识，便于跨窗交接核对工作建立在哪一版上。
为什么: 防止交接无法定位进度对应的版本(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Timestamp key progress and its baseline
text: Record only agreed key milestones. Each segment includes the current time and shared code-baseline identifier at that moment, allowing other windows to identify the version underlying the work.
rationale: Prevent handovers that cannot identify the version associated with progress, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 约定要计数先说明怎么算
条文: 任务明确要求统计时，先约定计数方法：一次命令从启动到退出算一次运行，执行完且结果可判定才算有效运行；一轮测试按约定的测试集合算，一次冲突修改交回算一次往返。分别报告并与过程记录核对；没有要求就不加计数。
为什么: 防止同一运行各按不同口径计数(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Define counting before measuring
text: When a task explicitly requests statistics, agree on counting first: a command from start to exit is one run, valid only when completed with a determinate result; one test round is the agreed set, and one returned conflict edit is one exchange. Report counts separately and reconcile them with records; do not add counts without a requirement.
rationale: Prevent different definitions of the same run count, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 量化停滞报进度不等答
条文: 任务约定的量化判据连续 2 轮均未向目标靠近，或员工窗已运行 4 小时，向{{总协调}}报告当前值、差距与下一步，并记入{{留痕处}}；报后继续当前工作，不停手等答。
为什么: 进度检查用于看见停滞，不把报告变成停工等答的关卡；是否可先做后报仍依本次授权。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Report stagnation without waiting
text: If agreed quantitative measures fail to move toward the target for two consecutive rounds, or an execution window has run four hours, report the current value, gap, and next step to {{总协调}} and record them in {{留痕处}}. Continue working rather than waiting for an answer.
rationale: Progress reports reveal stagnation rather than becoming permission checkpoints; act-and-report still follows current authorization.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 小项目交付前看最新要求
条文: 小规模时，交付前看当前对话新要求和现用{{口径件}}（若有），冲突取最新有效口径；变化记收到时刻与内容，更新受影响工作，不另建查收报表。
为什么: 少窗直接核对最新要求即可；源项目经验。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Check current requirements before small deliveries
text: At small scale, check new conversation requirements and the active {{口径件}}, if any, before delivery; use the latest effective decision when they conflict. Record receipt time and content of changes and update affected work without a separate receipt report.
rationale: A few windows can check current requirements directly; this reflects experience in the source project.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 交付前核对最新要求
条文: 交付前查相关新消息和{{口径件}}，同一节点1次；变更记收到时刻、内容及影响，按最新有效要求处理，不统计消息条数或改要求次数。
为什么: 防止交付仍按过期要求执行(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Check latest requirements before delivery
text: Before delivery, inspect relevant new messages and {{口径件}} once at the same milestone. Record receipt time, content, and impact of changes and follow the latest effective requirements; do not count messages or requirement revisions.
rationale: Prevent delivery based on expired requirements, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 明细外置主文只留索引
条文: 明细附表与分报告独立保存为数据件，主报告和进度记录只留路径与计数，不重复收录全文；正文有总量限制时，不以附节不计入规避。
为什么: 防止明细全文复抄撑大主报告(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Keep detail outside the main report
text: Save detailed tables and subsidiary reports separately as data artifacts. Main reports and progress records contain paths and counts, not duplicated full text. Where a body limit exists, do not evade it by declaring appended sections uncounted.
rationale: Prevent repeated detail from inflating main reports, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 按本次权限完成回报
条文: 只做本次授权工作，不扩面；必留项不改，可调须报项逐条说明。职责内操作自己做，不交{{决策者}}；红线先问，依本次权限与交付要求执行。
为什么: 防止可自行执行的操作被推回决策者(源项目经验)
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Deliver within current authorization
text: Perform only the currently authorized work without expanding scope. Preserve required items and explain each reportable adjustment. Perform authorized operations yourself rather than passing them to {{决策者}}. Ask first for exceptional actions and follow current permissions and delivery requirements.
rationale: Prevent authorized operations from being pushed back onto the decision maker, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 完整模块一窗负责到底
条文: 按完整成果派活，一窗能交全就由其核依据、组织助手、整合交付，不逐环节设长期岗位。明确授权的跨分工改动交付时列明，由相关负责人核，不因文件归属不同撤回。
为什么: 防止按环节转手导致无人交全(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: One window owns a complete module
text: Assign complete outputs. If one window can deliver the whole task, it verifies authorities, organizes helpers, integrates, and delivers without permanent stage-specific roles. List explicitly authorized cross-role changes at delivery for relevant owners to review; do not withdraw them merely because files have different owners.
rationale: Prevent stage-by-stage transfers from leaving no one responsible for complete delivery, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 跨位定因交足够能力者
条文: 跨位问题的定因与归属由具备足够能力的分工位负责，不把尚未查明的问题直接交给能力不足的执行窗(若设)。
为什么: 防止跨位问题未定因就交给能力不足者(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Assign cross-role diagnosis to sufficient capability
text: Cross-role diagnosis and ownership decisions belong to a role with sufficient capability; do not hand an undiagnosed problem directly to an insufficiently capable execution window, if such windows exist.
rationale: Prevent unresolved cross-role problems from being handed to underqualified executors, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 一窗一任务转交留历史
条文: 同一执行窗(若设)同时只做1项在办任务；转交沿用原记录、保留历史，不另建任务替代。
为什么: 防止一窗多活或转交丢失任务历史(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: One active task per execution window
text: Each execution window, if any, handles only one active task at a time. Transfers keep the original record and history rather than creating a replacement task.
rationale: Prevent multitasking windows and task-history loss during transfers, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 任务书先保存再派遣
条文: 跨窗派遣先保存任务书，再用一句明确执行身份的指令给出路径；任务、交接与归档细节写在任务书中，面向{{决策者}}的开窗操作提示另发，不混入执行要求。
为什么: 防止口头派遣缺少可回查的完整要求(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Save assignments before dispatch
text: Save a cross-window assignment first, then send its path with one instruction explicitly identifying the executor. Keep task, handover, and archival detail in the assignment; send opening instructions intended for {{决策者}} separately.
rationale: Prevent verbal assignments without recoverable complete requirements, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 任务说明交什么怎么算好
条文: 小中规模任务写清谁做、交什么、禁改项、存放处与完成要求；写作核章节设定，视频核脚本、时长、成片。数字要求给定值与允差，没有不造；未检查项单列，临时意见不自动成要求。
为什么: 先说清要交什么、怎样算好，不另搭多层文书或临时判据体系。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: State the output and acceptance conditions
text: Small and medium assignments state who works, the output, frozen items, location, and completion requirements. Check chapters against settings and videos against script, duration, and final footage. State numerical targets and tolerances when present without inventing them; list unchecked items separately and do not automatically promote temporary opinions into requirements.
rationale: Explain what to deliver and how to judge it without adding multiple documentation layers or ad hoc criteria.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 大型任务书保留实质
条文: 大规模任务写清谁来做、依据和已定要求、交付效果、检查办法、可改与不可改的范围、原始数据出处、交付去向及需要独立检查和尚未检查的事项。只检查本次相关内容，数字要求和允许差多少须预先给定；固定规矩只给位置，负责窗把安排记入{{留痕处}}。
为什么: 防止大型任务遗漏依据、边界与完成要求(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Keep substantial large-task requirements
text: Large assignments state the executor, authorities and settled requirements, delivery effect, checking methods, editable and frozen scope, raw-data sources, destination, independent checks, and unchecked items. Check only relevant content; numerical requirements and tolerances are predetermined. Link standing rules and let the responsible window record arrangements in {{留痕处}}.
rationale: Prevent large assignments from omitting authorities, limits, or completion requirements, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 能力匹配且不自行降档
条文: 模型能力档是能力下限，不指定唯一模型；子代理按任务难度和已知能力选用，复杂判断、轻量改写与读件抄数各用适配能力；入口受限就换可用入口，不自行降档，看图不交给不具备该能力的类型；回报首行写实际模型名。
为什么: 防止能力不匹配或因入口受限自行降档(源项目经验)
加回条件: 派用≥2家模型时加回。
title: Match capability without downgrading
text: A model capability tier is a minimum capability, not a unique model. Match helpers to task difficulty and known ability, using suitable capabilities for complex judgment, light rewriting, and reading or transcription. If an entry is unavailable, choose another available entry without downgrading. Do not assign visual tasks to incapable types; start reports with the actual model name.
rationale: Prevent capability mismatch or downgrading because an entry is restricted, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when delegating to at least two model providers.

短题: 模型口径只维护一处
条文: 主窗模型由{{决策者}}确定；子代理当前模型、档位和平台入口集中写入{{口径件}}，开窗和每次派遣前读，{{作业件}}只引用；不凭旧表或额度快照另立顺序，也不反复询问{{决策者}}。
为什么: 模型安排分散会让各窗反复询问，统一入口便于自行查到当前选择。
加回条件: 派用≥2家模型时加回。
title: Keep model arrangements in one place
text: {{决策者}} selects the main-window model. Maintain current helper models, tiers, and platform entries in {{口径件}}, read at window opening and before each dispatch; {{作业件}} only links it. Do not derive another order from old tables or quota snapshots or repeatedly ask {{决策者}}.
rationale: A shared entry prevents fragmented model arrangements and repeated questions across windows.
restore_condition: Restore when delegating to at least two model providers.

短题: 延期交付须有明确承接
条文: 本次应交的接续工作要么完成，要么明确交给一项已登记任务；不以本批暂不做、以后再铺开等说法代替承接安排。
为什么: 防止用以后再做掩盖无人承接的欠项(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Name an owner for deferred work
text: Complete continuation work owed by the current task or explicitly transfer it to a registered task. Do not substitute statements about doing it later or outside the current batch for an ownership arrangement.
rationale: Prevent future-work language from hiding unowned obligations, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 任务书长度服从说清
条文: 任务说明长短以讲清为准，不为凑篇幅删条目、合段或改变引用，不另设硬性长度上限。
为什么: 防止为凑长度删掉必要要求(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Assignment length follows clarity
text: Make assignments as long as necessary to explain the work. Do not delete items, merge paragraphs, or alter references to meet an invented size; add no hard length limit.
rationale: Prevent necessary requirements from being deleted to fit an arbitrary length, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 起草只用本次权威依据
条文: 新任务书只依{{作业件}}中任务书写法要求（G-0065、G-0069、G-0082）、本次事实与决定、点名的{{真源件}}及本位职责起草；不整读旧任务书、进度、审计或别位材料，不搬他项原话；同类旧任务只按需查结论与待办。
为什么: 防止旧任务口径与原话混入新任务(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Draft only from current authorities
text: Draft new assignments from the assignment requirements in {{作业件}} (G-0065, G-0069, G-0082), current facts and decisions, named {{真源件}}, and the role's responsibilities. Do not read entire old assignments, progress records, audits, or other roles' materials, or import unrelated original statements. Consult old similar tasks only for needed conclusions and remaining work.
rationale: Prevent old task requirements and unrelated original wording from entering a new task, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 委托起草不转移核实责任
条文: 派遣方核实原始数据并给准确出处；助手起草只负责转写并标待核，负责窗开工时核对版本和适用范围。同一版本已经核过的数字可复用，不重复测量；不能把起草完成当作事实已核实。
为什么: 防止助手转写被当作事实已核(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Delegated drafting does not transfer verification
text: The dispatcher verifies raw data and supplies precise sources. Helpers transcribe and mark verification pending; the responsible window checks versions and applicability when starting. Reuse values already verified for the same version without measuring again; drafting does not establish verified facts.
rationale: Prevent delegated transcription from being treated as fact verification, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 大型量测先固定取数安排
条文: 需要集中测量时，每个数字写明来源，并预先确定测几次、在哪看结果、用什么配置和多少样本，未写次数按1次。重复或重跑说明理由，后续任务沿用同一安排；同一问题不能靠换任务名重置次数，超过约定上限交负责人决定并留痕。
为什么: 量过的参数可直接沿用，无须重复测量
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Fix measurement arrangements before large studies
text: For concentrated measurements, state each value's source and predetermine repetitions, result location, configuration, and sample size; absent a count, measure once. Explain repetitions and reruns and reuse the same arrangement in later tasks. Renaming a task does not reset counts; the owner decides and records any excess over agreed limits.
rationale: Previously measured parameters can be reused without repeating measurements.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 派出后改要求须明示留痕
条文: 派遣方写明交付去向与完成要求；派出后调整须授权方明示并记{{留痕处}}，执行者不私改。内容与使用条件未变的已检部分复用结果，不重查。
为什么: 防止执行者私改已定要求或重复检查(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Record explicit changes after dispatch
text: The dispatcher states delivery destination and completion requirements. Changes after dispatch require explicit authorization and a record in {{留痕处}}; executors do not change them privately. Reuse checked results when content and conditions are unchanged.
rationale: Prevent executors from changing agreed requirements or repeating checks unnecessarily, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 子代理只带所需上下文
条文: 派子代理只给本次任务、{{作业件}}点名段与所需材料，不附整份{{规矩总件}}；共用行为约束只维护在子代理定义，任务书不复抄。
为什么: 防止无关依据挤占上下文并复制造规矩(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Give helpers only necessary context
text: Give helpers the current task, named passages from {{作业件}}, and necessary materials rather than the entire {{规矩总件}}. Maintain shared behavior constraints only in helper definitions, not copied into assignments.
rationale: Prevent irrelevant authorities from consuming context and creating copied rule sets, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 派遣难度先说判断依据
条文: 派遣前列出要改的文件、涉及的模块和代码仓，以及是否迁移数据，据此安排足够能力的执行者。项目若已有任务难度分档，须同时给出各档的数字门槛；没有就直接说明本次难点，不引用未定义的档位。执行者可提出需要更强能力，并记入{{留痕处}}，不擅自降低已定要求。
为什么: 防止无明确判尺却低估难度和执行能力(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Explain assignment difficulty with evidence
text: Before dispatch, list changed files, modules, repositories, and whether data migrates, then choose sufficiently capable executors. If difficulty tiers exist, include their numerical thresholds; otherwise state the actual difficulty without citing undefined tiers. Executors may request stronger capability and record it in {{留痕处}}, but cannot lower requirements.
rationale: Prevent underestimated difficulty and capability without an explicit measure, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 并行先拆清责任面
条文: 并行先列子任务、责任文件、依赖与并行组；同组责任面无冲突才并派，子代理只改名下文件。
为什么: 防止并行任务互改责任文件(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Separate responsibilities before parallel work
text: Before parallel execution, list subtasks, owned files, dependencies, and parallel groups. Dispatch a group together only if responsibilities do not conflict; helpers modify only their assigned files.
rationale: Prevent parallel tasks from overwriting files owned by one another, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 能力表只记已核事实
条文: 模型能力表区分已验证能力、已知限制和待验证状态；未核仍写未核，不把相近型号的结论或旧派遣顺序当作本型号的能力证据。
为什么: 补上指定路径写盘的指令，不等于已证明能成功写盘；相近型号的表现和旧派遣顺序，也不能替代本型号的实测。
加回条件: 派用≥2家模型时加回。
title: Record only verified model capabilities
text: Capability tables distinguish verified abilities, known limitations, and unverified states. Keep unverified claims marked unverified; related models' behavior and old dispatch order are not evidence for this model.
rationale: Adding a path-writing instruction does not establish successful writing, and neighboring model results cannot substitute for a direct measurement.
restore_condition: Restore when delegating to at least two model providers.

短题: 派遣交代层次权限与交回
条文: 子代理派遣说明所处层次、任务类型、能否再派、等待规则、产出位置与回报格式；不让子代理自行猜测权限或交回方式。
为什么: 防止子代理自行猜权限与交回方式(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: State helper authority and handback
text: Helper assignments state their execution level, task type, whether further delegation is allowed, waiting rules, output location, and report format. Helpers must not guess their authority or delivery method.
rationale: Prevent helpers from guessing permissions and handback requirements, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 独立任务并派步骤一次写全
条文: 独立子任务一次并派；有先后依赖的步骤在同份指令写全，不让子代理空等补令。
为什么: 防止独立任务串等或子代理空等补令(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Dispatch independent tasks together
text: Dispatch independent subtasks together. Put all dependency-ordered steps into the same instructions rather than making helpers wait for supplementary instructions.
rationale: Prevent serial waiting between independent tasks and idle helpers awaiting further instructions, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 按事件唤醒交回即结束
条文: 工作窗只按新任务或协作事件唤醒，不定时巡查；子代理靠完成通知，不休眠轮询。请裁提交问题即结束回合，答后续派；做完交回即结束，不起后台空等消息。
为什么: 交回后再堆后台休眠任务，只会积累无用进程。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Wake on events and end after handback
text: Wake work windows only for new tasks or collaboration events rather than periodic polling. Helpers rely on completion notifications, not sleep polling. Submit ruling questions and end the turn, resuming after answers; finish and return without background jobs merely waiting for messages.
rationale: Background sleep tasks left after handback accumulate useless processes.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 接力异常只调整本次组织
条文: 预计任务将跨负责窗换窗，或已发生幻觉返工、接力断线时，调整本次任务的执行层次与交接方式；不把单项回退扩成全部任务的常态流程。
为什么: 防止接力断线后仍沿用失效组织(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Adjust only the affected relay arrangement
text: When a task is expected to span owner-window replacement, or hallucination rework or a broken relay has occurred, adjust that task's execution levels and handover. Do not generalize a local rollback into a permanent process for all tasks.
rationale: Prevent continued use of an ineffective arrangement after a broken relay, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 出题交事实与已定裁决
条文: 出题写事实与已定裁决，不把讨论原话直接粘成执行要求；必须逐字交付的文案例外，仍以{{真源件}}原文为准。
为什么: 防止讨论原话被当成已定要求(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Assignments contain facts and settled decisions
text: Write facts and settled rulings in assignments rather than pasting discussion as executable requirements. Verbatim delivery copy is an exception and still follows the original {{真源件}}.
rationale: Prevent discussion wording from masquerading as settled requirements, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 模型默认选择配明确例外
条文: 模型口径写清默认选择与例外：默认模型排队或限流，其他模型明显更适合且留一句原因，或{{决策者}}当次点名；照默认与例外派遣，不要求各窗逐次计算配比。
为什么: 若需优先利用会周期重置的模型资源，默认选择加少数例外比逐窗计算配比更容易执行。
加回条件: 派用≥2家模型时加回。
title: Give model defaults explicit exceptions
text: Model arrangements specify a default and exceptions: the default is queued or rate-limited, another model is materially better with one recorded reason, or {{决策者}} names one for the current task. Dispatch by those rules rather than requiring each window to calculate proportions.
rationale: A default and a few exceptions use periodically resetting resources more simply than per-window proportional calculations.
restore_condition: Restore when delegating to at least two model providers.

短题: 中项目由负责人直接派活
条文: 中规模时，前端、后端、测试等现有负责人直接派助手并整合各自任务，不增只转述、收报告的层级。
为什么: 多一层只转述、不实际交付的角色，会增加来回沟通而不增加成果。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Medium-project owners dispatch directly
text: At medium scale, existing frontend, backend, and testing owners directly assign helpers and integrate their tasks. Do not add layers that only relay messages and collect reports.
rationale: Relay-only roles increase communication without increasing delivered work.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 大型执行层仅按需增设
条文: 大规模协作也默认由任务负责人直接派助手并整合交付；只有任务需要长时间连续接力、{{决策者}}又不在时，才按任务书增加1层实际组织执行的人，不加只传话的层级。负责改写的助手再派任务只限只读查资料。
为什么: 防止无须接力却层层转派任务(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Add large-project execution layers only when needed
text: Even large collaborations default to task owners directly assigning helpers and integrating delivery. Only when a task needs prolonged continuous relay and {{决策者}} is absent may its assignment add one person who actually organizes execution, never a relay-only layer. Helpers responsible for rewriting may delegate only read-only research.
rationale: Prevent needless layers of task redistribution when relay is unnecessary, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 可合并返工不另开窗
条文: 审计返工能够并入同一工作线下一任务的，合并处理，不另开员工窗。
为什么: 防止可合并的返工重复开窗(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Combine rework without opening another window
text: When audit rework can join the next task on the same work line, combine it instead of opening another execution window.
rationale: Prevent duplicate windows for rework that can be combined, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 并发不加虚构上限
条文: 模型已确认没有并发限制时，不为省用量另设窗数、轮数或总调用次数上限；仍遵守实际预算、设备资源与供应方额度限制。
为什么: 并发上限只认已确认的供应方限制和真实预算、设备边界，不能臆造限制，也不能臆造无限额度。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Do not invent concurrency ceilings
text: When a model is confirmed to have no concurrency limit, do not invent window, round, or total-call limits merely to conserve usage. Still respect real budgets, device resources, and provider quotas.
rationale: Concurrency ceilings follow confirmed provider limits and actual budgets and devices; neither limits nor unlimited quota may be invented.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 修改任务交有修改权限者
条文: 若助手的角色明确只有阅读或诊断权限，需要它继续修改时应另派有修改权限的角色；不是每次读完资料都必须换助手，少窗项目无需另设一套角色切换手续。
为什么: 曾把只负责诊断的子代理续用于修复，对方因角色权限拒改，白白空转一轮。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Assign modifications to authorized roles
text: If a helper's role explicitly permits only reading or diagnosis, assign subsequent modification to a role allowed to modify. Reading does not always require changing helpers, and small projects need no separate role-switch procedure.
rationale: A diagnostic-only helper was previously reused for repair, wasting a turn when its permissions required refusal.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 检查要求先写明再使用
条文: 共用完成要求先写入{{规矩总件}}或{{作业件}}，单分工要求入职责说明；未预定的不能临时判别人不合格，检查意见不擅换{{真源件}}现行说明。
为什么: 防止用未定判据临时判不合格(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Publish acceptance requirements before use
text: Write shared completion requirements into {{规矩总件}} or {{作业件}}, and role-specific requirements into that role's responsibilities. Do not fail someone against unannounced criteria or let checking opinions replace current {{真源件}} descriptions.
rationale: Prevent retroactive rejection using unset criteria, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 检查成果不额外加手续
条文: 只按预定成果与必要质量检查，如稿件合大纲、成片合脚本；必要自查照做，未检项单列。不临时加报告、反复重读或重复检查作交付前置；约定重读1遍就1遍，不无故加次。
为什么: 检查拦未做好的成果，不靠层层障碍防错；自查和实质验收仍须做。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Check outputs without adding procedures
text: Check only agreed outputs and necessary quality, such as draft-outline consistency or script-video consistency. Perform necessary self-checks and list unchecked items. Do not add reports, repeated reading, or duplicate checks as delivery prerequisites; one agreed reread means one without unjustified repetitions.
rationale: Checks reject unfinished outputs rather than creating layers of obstacles; self-checking and substantive acceptance remain necessary.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 失败不削弱校验
条文: 校验、测试或构建失败，不关既定警告检查，不弱化断言、篡改验证锚点或跳失败换通过；实现错就修，疑判据错则保留失败并在{{留痕处}}记阻塞。
为什么: 防止削弱检查掩盖真实失败(源项目经验)
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Never weaken failing checks
text: When validation, tests, or builds fail, do not disable established warnings, weaken assertions, alter verification anchors, or skip failures for a passing result. Repair incorrect implementation; if criteria may be wrong, retain the failure and record the blocker in {{留痕处}}.
rationale: Prevent weakened checks from hiding real failures, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 验收结论独立于生产指挥
条文: 若任务已安排独立验收，验收者只对检查结论负责，生产负责人不能代定结论；不因规模大就强制新增常设验收岗位。
为什么: 防止生产指挥代定验收结论(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Keep acceptance independent of production command
text: When independent acceptance is assigned, the reviewer owns checking conclusions and production owners cannot decide them. Large scale alone does not require a permanent acceptance role.
rationale: Prevent production command from deciding independent acceptance conclusions, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 小项目按约定直接验收
条文: 小规模时，{{决策者}}看{{成品}}与必要验证结果验收，不常设独立审计或因平台增派；高风险不免检，须独立检查时在任务说明点名。
为什么: 低风险任务本不必专派检查，减量不能变成高风险免检。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Accept small projects directly as agreed
text: At small scale, {{决策者}} accepts {{成品}} and necessary verification results without permanent independent audits or extra reviewers based on platform. High-risk work still requires checks; name any independent checking in the assignment.
rationale: Low-risk work need not receive dedicated review, but reduced procedure cannot exempt high-risk work.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 独立审计按风险只一道
条文: 低风险默认不审；其余依风险与任务说明，一般任务按需减量读改动和已有证据，不重跑、不挡后续，高风险交付前完整审计。{{总协调}}另派非起草者以新上下文承担，最多一道；明示能力要求，不因平台加派或额度降档。
为什么: 审计应按真实风险减量，不应层层加码妨碍下一步；高风险仍需足够能力。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Use one risk-based independent audit
text: Default to no audit for low risk. For other work, follow risk and assignment: ordinary tasks may use reduced review of changes and existing evidence without rerunning or blocking continuation; high-risk work receives complete review before delivery. {{总协调}} assigns a non-author with fresh context, at most one audit, with explicit capability requirements; platform or quota does not justify extra reviewers or downgrading.
rationale: Risk-based review avoids obstructing progress through repeated escalation while preserving sufficient capability for high risk.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 大型代码审计按风险分层
条文: 高风险代码、部署、数据安全及校验工具改动，在交付或集成前完整审计，并按风险选择审计能力；一般改码在集成后减量审计，不挡交付，有缺陷再补修；改表、素材、文书、单文件小修及仅改测试等低风险任务默认不审，点名则审。
为什么: 按实际风险安排检查，避免低风险任务反复重审和层层加码挡住交付。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Review large code tasks by risk
text: Fully audit high-risk code, deployments, data security, and validation-tool changes before delivery or integration, with capability suited to risk. Review ordinary code after integration with reduced scope, without blocking delivery, and repair discovered defects afterward. Low-risk tables, assets, documents, small single-file fixes, and test-only changes default to no audit unless named.
rationale: Review actual risk rather than repeatedly auditing low-risk tasks or blocking delivery through added layers.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 减量审计只读已有证据
条文: 减量代码审计只读差异、收口报告及已有测试证据，核改动行为、结果真实性、跨任务影响与越界；不重跑构建和测试，不核过程文书，不另列完整审计的改动面外核查表。
为什么: 减量的目的不是再执行一遍验证，而是用已有结果检查真实缺陷；避免重复构建、测试和无关文书检查增加负担。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Reduced audits read existing evidence only
text: Reduced code audits read differences, completion reports, and existing test evidence, checking behavior, truthful results, cross-task effects, and scope. Do not rerun builds or tests, inspect procedural paperwork, or add the out-of-scope checklist used for full audits.
rationale: Reduced review uses existing results to find defects rather than repeating verification and unrelated paperwork.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 完整审计按问题限读
条文: 完整审计围绕本次判据、测试范围、不做事项、改动差异、收口报告及对应数据取证；过程记录只定位冲突、自主假设、授权与返工，不整读任务书和全部历史材料。
为什么: 防止无关历史挤占本次核查(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Limit full-audit reading to the question
text: Full audits gather evidence for current criteria, test scope, exclusions, changes, completion reports, and corresponding data. Use process records only to locate conflicts, autonomous assumptions, authorization, and rework; do not read all assignments and history.
rationale: Prevent unrelated history from crowding out the current review, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 审计断言须有实据
条文: 审计逐项列断言、可定位证据、必要原样输出与判定；返工项及轮次记{{留痕处}}。缺证写未核与原因，不以猜测、旧报告冒充本次核实。
为什么: 防止无据断言冒充已核事实(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Support audit assertions with evidence
text: List each assertion, locatable evidence, necessary unmodified output, and judgment. Record rework items and rounds in {{留痕处}}. Mark missing evidence unverified with a reason; guesses and old reports cannot substitute for current verification.
rationale: Prevent unsupported assertions from being treated as verified facts, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 返工只因成果未达标
条文: 审计按成果与行为是否达约定判定；不影响交付事实的过程计数、时刻、行号、署名或段落形式笔误可勘误，不列成果缺陷、不据此返工。真实结果或完成断言不实仍须查证处理。
为什么: 防止形式笔误被当成果缺陷(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Rework addresses unmet outputs
text: Judge audits by agreed outputs and behavior. Correct harmless typos in process counts, times, line numbers, signatures, or paragraph formatting without classifying them as output defects or demanding rework. Still investigate false actual results and completion claims.
rationale: Prevent harmless formatting errors from being classified as output defects, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 环境限制单列
条文: 因权限或环境无法核实的事项单列环境限制，说明不是本任务成果问题，不混入未核计数，也不据此判成果返工。
为什么: 核查条件不足不等于成果没做好；分开记录，避免把环境问题算成任务缺陷。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: List environment limitations separately
text: List matters unverifiable because of permissions or environment as environment limitations. Explain that they are not output defects; do not mix them into unchecked-item counts or demand output rework on that basis.
rationale: Insufficient checking conditions do not mean poor work; separate records avoid misclassifying environmental failures.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 完整审计明示外溢核查
条文: 完整审计列明本次改动可能影响的其他任务及在用路径，即使这些内容未被修改，也逐项标明已核或未核；确无关联影响才写无，不把没查当成无影响。
为什么: 防止没查外溢就报无影响(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: State cross-task checks in full audits
text: A full audit lists other tasks and active paths potentially affected by the change, marking each checked or unchecked even if unmodified. State no impact only when none is related, not when impact was not investigated.
rationale: Prevent unexamined effects from being reported as absent, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 越界与共享改动核实
条文: 代码审计把实际改动逐项对照约定边界，越界逐项列出并区分有无授权留痕；共享内容只改本任务负责的行与键，其他分工位的改动及关联既有用例不得误改。
为什么: 防止越界或误改他人共享内容(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Check scope and shared edits
text: Code audits compare actual changes individually with agreed limits and list scope expansion with or without authorization records. Shared content changes only the task's owned lines and keys, never other roles' changes or related existing tests by mistake.
rationale: Prevent unauthorized scope expansion or accidental changes to others' shared content, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 复审只核上轮返工项
条文: 复审只核{{留痕处}}中上轮返工项及反证，不重跑完整核项，不扩同类边角；不借返工追加测试、门槛、审计轮次或补文书。
为什么: 审计应当减量而非层层加码；若每次复审都扩大核查范围，一轮返工就会变成另一轮全新审计。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Recheck only preceding rework items
text: Rechecks examine only preceding rework items in {{留痕处}} and counterevidence. Do not rerun the full checklist or expand to similar edge cases. Do not add tests, thresholds, audit rounds, or documentation through rework.
rationale: Review should reduce work rather than expand every recheck into an entirely new audit.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 复审新问题分流
条文: 复审限上轮返工项；新发现的高风险问题是例外，纳入本次返工，其余记存量，由{{总协调}}另行安排，不塞回本轮范围。
为什么: 防止非高风险新问题扩入复审(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Separate newly discovered recheck issues
text: Rechecks cover preceding rework items. Newly discovered high-risk issues are exceptions included in current rework; record other issues as existing backlog for {{总协调}} to arrange separately, not as additions to this round.
rationale: Prevent non-high-risk discoveries from expanding a recheck, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 三轮返工换做法
条文: 同一任务独立检查后返工达到3轮时，不再继续叠补丁；由任务负责人更换做法，或明确遗留问题后按约定交付。
为什么: 防止多轮返工仍无休止叠补丁(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Change approach after three rework rounds
text: After three rework rounds following independent checking of one task, stop stacking patches. The task owner changes approach or explicitly states remaining issues and delivers as agreed.
rationale: Prevent endless patch accumulation across repeated rework, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 已检查且未变的不用重查
条文: 内容与使用条件未变，自己、助手均复用结果，不重查；未另约定只查1次，重查写原因。改稿改片仅查受影响部分；修后复查及预定换设备、另一人独检照做，全达标即交付。
为什么: 跑过的验证和参数直接取用，不因多派一层拖住交付。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Reuse unchanged verified results
text: Owners and helpers reuse results when content and conditions are unchanged. Unless otherwise agreed, check once and explain repeats. After draft or video edits, check affected parts only; perform repair rechecks and agreed device changes or independent reviews, then deliver once all requirements pass.
rationale: Reuse completed verification and parameters rather than delaying delivery through another delegation layer.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 验证范围随改动
条文: 代码验证依任务书，只跑新增、改动及直接引用改动符号、数据或夹具的相邻测试；特殊环境仅点名运行，不自加整套、专项或画面取证。审计核无理由的超额验证。
为什么: 不能因为执行者以为应该再跑，就自行增加验证；原意是去掉多余测试，已有量测直接复用。
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Match verification scope to changes
text: Code verification follows the assignment and runs only new, changed, and neighboring tests directly referencing changed symbols, data, or fixtures. Run special environments only when named; do not add full suites, specialist checks, or screen evidence. Audits examine unjustified excess verification.
rationale: An executor's belief that more checks would help does not authorize extra verification; reuse existing measurements.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 测试结果逐名留存对账
条文: 每轮完整测试输出另存日志，{{留痕处}}仅记路径、通过失败计数与失败名单；逐名区分新增与改动面外存量失败，依约定处理。名单取自日志，不为看名单重跑整集；修后仅复验失败项。
为什么: 改动面外已有失败不能算成本任务新增；完整输出已经包含失败名单，无须为了读取它再执行一遍测试。
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Keep test results with named failures
text: Save each full test-round output separately. {{留痕处}} contains only its path, pass/fail counts, and failure names. Distinguish new failures from pre-existing failures outside the change scope by name and handle as agreed. Read names from existing logs rather than rerunning the suite; recheck only failed items after repair.
rationale: Existing out-of-scope failures are not introduced by the current task, and saved output already supplies their names.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 量化任务只重量目标项
条文: 任务书已有量化目标时，目标不降；迭代只重量受改动直接影响的目标项一次，全套量测仅对最终产物做一次。没有约定量化判据，不得借此加测加轮。
为什么: 源项目量化任务要求调到达标，但这不意味着每次都重做整套量测，更不能借量化要求给原本没有量化判据的任务加测。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Remeasure only affected quantitative targets
text: Keep assignment targets unchanged. During iteration, remeasure directly affected target items once; perform the full measurement only once on the final output. Without agreed quantitative criteria, do not use this rule to add measurements or rounds.
rationale: Quantitative targets do not authorize repeatedly measuring all items or adding criteria where none were agreed.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 独立测试环境按需启用
条文: 只有指定测试确实依赖独立环境时才启用，测试数据放在代码仓外；测试不需要时不启动额外环境。
为什么: 防止无须测试环境也启动额外实例(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Use separate test environments only as needed
text: Start an independent environment only when a named test actually requires it, keeping test data outside the repository. Do not start extra environments for tests that need none.
rationale: Prevent unnecessary additional test instances, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 调试信息在场照常取证
条文: 运行验收取证可以保留调试信息，不得仅因调试信息出现在取证画面中而扣分。
为什么: 防止仅因调试字在场误判成果(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Allow diagnostic information in evidence
text: Runtime acceptance evidence may retain diagnostic information. Do not deduct acceptance credit solely because diagnostic text appears in captured evidence.
rationale: Prevent output rejection merely because diagnostic text is visible, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 诊断证据不强占展示面
条文: 可追溯的时间与状态证据由诊断采集承接，不强迫面向{{受众}}的界面永久显示指定调试标记。
为什么: 防止诊断标记永久挤占展示界面(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Keep diagnostics out of permanent presentation
text: Collect traceable time and state evidence through diagnostic acquisition rather than forcing the {{受众}} interface to display prescribed debugging markers permanently.
rationale: Prevent diagnostic markers from permanently occupying the product interface, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 功能自动验体验另看
条文: 能由断言、日志、计数或导出件判定的功能先自动验证，不让{{决策者}}陪测或重复取图代替；自动通过却仍有外观、体验异常，或整体完成后需检查真实使用感受，再由{{决策者}}决定体验验证。
为什么: 自动化先解决功能问题，真人体验关注随意使用时暴露的需求与感受，而不是再替工具重复检查功能。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Automate functional checks; review experience separately
text: Verify functions determined by assertions, logs, counts, or exports automatically first; do not make {{决策者}} assist testing or repeat screenshots instead. If appearance or experience still seems wrong after passing checks, or complete work needs real-use review, {{决策者}} decides that review separately.
rationale: Automation handles function; human experience review concerns issues in free use rather than repeating tool-verifiable checks.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 一致性量测写数字允差
条文: 需要量测一致性时，由派遣方预先给出数字允差，不用基本一致等含糊词；审计核对判据有无、允差是否为定值。
为什么: 含糊的一致性描述不能给出明确通过条件，容易让制作与审查各按自己的理解判定。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: State numerical consistency tolerances
text: For consistency measurements, the dispatcher supplies numerical tolerances in advance rather than vague terms such as approximately consistent. Audits check that criteria exist and tolerances are fixed values.
rationale: Vague consistency descriptions let makers and reviewers apply incompatible pass conditions.
