restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 整体验证另安排不逐项等
条文: 若已约定跨多个模块的整体回归测试，由现有测试负责人统一安排；已设审查席时可按授权协调，不因每项任务交付就额外等一轮整体验证。
为什么: 防止每单交付都等整体验证(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Arrange aggregate verification separately
text: When cross-module regression is agreed, the existing test owner arranges it centrally. An established review role may coordinate within authorization, but each task delivery does not wait for an additional aggregate round.
rationale: Prevent every task delivery from waiting for aggregate verification, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 定稿原型进入验收依据
条文: 交互原型经{{决策者}}定稿后入需求书作验收依据；变更只改需求书，不回写定稿原型。字段含义、优先级等行为语义依需求书文字，不凭图推定。
为什么: 原型会决定后续研发内容；先按{{决策者}}修正迭代到满意再定稿，避免把未经确认的版本直接作为交付依据。
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Approved prototypes become acceptance authorities
text: After {{决策者}} finalizes an interaction prototype, include it in the requirements as an acceptance authority. Make subsequent changes in requirements, not the finalized prototype. Field meanings, priorities, and other behavior follow written requirements, not deductions from diagrams.
rationale: Prototypes affect later development and need approval first rather than an unconfirmed version becoming delivery authority.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 重计算只验最终输入
条文: 离线批量计算只对最终输入执行一次验收计算，不给中间版本重复安排施工、集成双轮验证。
为什么: 防止中间输入重复消耗验收计算(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Run expensive acceptance only on final input
text: For offline batch computations, perform acceptance computation once on final inputs rather than repeating construction and integration verification for intermediate versions.
rationale: Prevent intermediate inputs from repeatedly consuming acceptance computation, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 边界作业做法分层
条文: {{规矩总件}}只收权责、红线、项目级判据；共用作业要求归{{作业件}}；易变做法、参数归位内做法件或工具，由分工位维护，不逐项升公共规矩。
为什么: 规矩控制边界，不应束缚做法选择；易变做法不宜全升为共同约束。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Separate safeguards, operations, and methods
text: {{规矩总件}} holds authority, exceptional actions, and project-level criteria. Shared operational requirements belong in {{作业件}}. Roles maintain volatile methods and parameters locally or in tools rather than promoting each to shared rules.
rationale: Rules limit authority without restricting methods; volatile methods should not all become shared constraints.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 事故先修工具补错不成规
条文: 一次事故先修工具或缺省值，不立长期规矩；只补错项1次、记本任务，不入长期骨架或记忆。同类累计≥3次且无法工具化才考虑立规；教训先转工具或本次一次性核对。
为什么: 一次错误不能变成所有后续任务反复承担的限制。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Fix tools before creating rules after incidents
text: After one incident, fix tools or defaults rather than creating a permanent rule. Correct the erroneous item once and record it in the task, not enduring templates or memory. Consider a rule only after at least three similar incidents when automation is infeasible; first turn lessons into tools or a one-time task check.
rationale: One mistake must not become a burden repeatedly imposed on all later tasks.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 可执行约束优先工具化
条文: 工具、自动检查或缺省值能实现的约束交工具执行；规矩只留入口指针，不让执行窗(若设)反复按长文手工操作。
为什么: 防止可自动的检查反复手做(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Automate executable constraints first
text: Use tools, automated checks, or defaults for constraints they can implement. Rules retain entry pointers rather than making execution windows repeatedly perform long written procedures.
rationale: Prevent repeated manual performance of automatable checks, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 设当前口径试行有期限
条文: {{口径件}}集中现行口径。新立闸、锁、试行规矩写防什么、到期日（默认7天）与数字撤除条件（如到期前拦下真问题0次就撤）；到期无人带数续期即失效归档，续期写新日期。当窗指示与单内临时闸用完即撤，不走7天到期。少窗可在现有记录单列一节，不另建审查流程。
为什么: 限制不能只加不减,临时安排要有退出时点;源项目定过一次事故不立规矩,同类问题反复出现、又做不成工具时才立。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Give temporary rules an expiry
text: {{口径件}} collects current decisions. New checks, locks, and trial rules state their purpose, expiry (seven days by default), and numerical removal condition, such as zero real problems caught before expiry. Expired rules lapse and archive unless renewed with measurements and a new date. Remove current-window instructions and task-local checks after use rather than waiting seven days. A few windows can use a section in existing records without a new review process.
rationale: Limits need removal as well as addition; one incident does not justify a rule unless problems recur and tools cannot address them.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 现行正文不叠历史
条文: 现行正文只留生效要求，变更直接改正文并各记版本日志；废止记录、替代链与历史版本另存，不堆补充、覆盖或作废告示。
为什么: 防止现行正文叠留失效要求(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Keep history out of current rules
text: Current text contains effective requirements only. Edit it directly and record version changes separately. Store repealed entries, replacement relationships, and historical versions elsewhere instead of accumulating supplements, overrides, or repeal notices.
rationale: Prevent current text from retaining expired requirements, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 当次要求不自动成规
条文: 本次要求、特许、判据或局部流程回退只记本次原话与时刻，用完撤，不扩到他项或例行安排；仅{{决策者}}明示以后通用、全部回退或直接改规矩才调长期范围，存疑按本次。
为什么: 一次安排不能成为以后默认的授权与要求。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Current requirements do not become permanent rules
text: Record current requirements, exceptions, criteria, and local rollbacks only with current wording and time; remove them after use rather than applying them to other tasks or routines. Change enduring scope only when {{决策者}} explicitly makes it general, orders a complete rollback, or changes rules directly. Treat uncertain cases as task-local.
rationale: One arrangement does not establish future default authority or requirements.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 文书超约定字节先减旧文
条文: 若项目给规矩和{{接管件}}设长度上限，在各自文件头写明上限数字，并统一按 UTF-8 字节计算。超限还要新增时，同次删去或归档不少于新增字节数的旧内容，不按句数或段数含糊抵算。
为什么: 防止超限文书继续只增不减(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Remove old text before exceeding byte limits
text: If the project limits rule and {{接管件}} lengths, state each numerical ceiling at the file's start and count UTF-8 bytes consistently. When adding above the limit, remove or archive at least as many old bytes in the same change, not an approximate number of sentences or paragraphs.
rationale: Prevent already oversized documents from continuing to grow, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 改版统一登记免重复确认
条文: {{作业件}}改版由{{总协调}}统一登记，各分工位只引用现行版；下一份任务书引用新版即视为已读，不另发已读确认。
为什么: 防止改版后重复索要已读确认(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Register revisions centrally without read receipts
text: {{总协调}} registers revisions of {{作业件}} centrally. Roles reference only the current version; citation of the new version in the next assignment counts as read without a separate acknowledgment.
rationale: Prevent duplicate read acknowledgments after revisions, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 不追改在跑与历史任务书
条文: 在跑与已结束任务书不回写追改；执行中新增授权要求另在{{留痕处}}明示，按最新有效口径继续。通用旧句更新职责说明与共享骨架供后续任务引用，不重写历史。
为什么: 防止追改历史混淆当时依据(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Do not rewrite running or historical assignments
text: Do not retrospectively edit active or completed assignments. State new execution requirements and authorizations separately in {{留痕处}}, then continue under the latest effective decisions. Update responsibilities and shared templates for future assignments without rewriting history.
rationale: Prevent retrospective changes from obscuring the authority in force at the time, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 作业规矩改字集中授权
条文: {{作业件}}由{{总协调}}或其明确授权者修订；若已设审查席，可按授权提出建议或修订，未设就由现有负责人处理。改动须保留决定记录，取向问题仍交{{决策者}}拍板。
为什么: 防止未授权者各改作业口径(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Centralize authority for operational-rule edits
text: {{总协调}} or an explicitly authorized person revises {{作业件}}. An established review role may suggest or revise within authorization; otherwise existing owners handle it. Retain decision records and leave direction questions to {{决策者}}.
rationale: Prevent unauthorized parties from independently changing operational rules, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 规矩变更与需求分流
条文: 收到要求先辨明是否修改现行规矩句；要改规矩的交{{总协调}}处理，其余作为任务需求记入{{留痕处}}，不把普通需求自动升格为规矩。
为什么: 防止普通需求被升格为长期规矩(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Separate rule changes from ordinary requirements
text: On receiving a requirement, identify whether it changes an existing rule. Refer rule changes to {{总协调}}; record other requests as task requirements in {{留痕处}} rather than automatically promoting them into rules.
rationale: Prevent ordinary requests from becoming permanent rules, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 历史决议不代替现行依据
条文: 历史决议只供追溯；现行作业查{{作业件}}，当期口径查{{口径件}}最新生效记录，废止内容按废止记录核对，不从历史账恢复执行。
为什么: 防止从历史账恢复失效规矩(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Historical decisions do not replace current authority
text: Use historical decisions only for tracing. Consult current {{作业件}} for operations and latest effective entries in {{口径件}} for current decisions. Check repealed content against repeal records rather than reviving it from history.
rationale: Prevent expired rules from being restored from historical ledgers, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 公共规矩只留权威指针
条文: 入口、职责说明和任务书只引用现行{{规矩总件}}、{{作业件}}、相关{{真源件}}及{{口径件}}，不抄条文另造底线；位内做法参数另存入口。真实偏离逐条写原条、改法、理由，不混入照办、不适用或历史错账。
为什么: 防止复抄公共规矩另立底线(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Shared rules retain authoritative pointers only
text: Entries, responsibility descriptions, and assignments reference current {{规矩总件}}, {{作业件}}, related {{真源件}}, and {{口径件}} rather than copying provisions into another safeguard set. Keep local methods and parameters separately. For actual deviations, state the original provision, change, and reason individually, not mixed with compliance, inapplicability, or historical bookkeeping errors.
rationale: Prevent copied shared rules from establishing another authority, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 精简保留位内判据入口
条文: 精简分工位职责说明时保留位内判据入口；正文减量不等于删去判据本身。
为什么: 防止精简时连判据入口一起删(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Keep local criteria pointers when condensing
text: When condensing role descriptions, retain pointers to that role's criteria. Reducing body text does not mean deleting the criteria themselves.
rationale: Prevent condensation from also removing criteria entries, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 分层接棒入口唯一
条文: 执行窗(若设)依任务记录接棒，位主依职责说明和{{接管件}}接棒，不设平行记忆；现状、在办、待补、存量缺陷与下一步只记对应接棒处，别处留指针，历史另存。
为什么: 防止多份接棒现状各自过期(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Use one handover entry at each level
text: Execution windows, if any, resume from task records; role owners resume from responsibilities and {{接管件}}, without parallel memories. Record current state, active work, omissions, existing defects, and next steps only in the corresponding handover location; use pointers elsewhere and keep history separate.
rationale: Prevent multiple handover-state copies from expiring independently, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 记忆不另立规矩
条文: 记忆只存本窗职责内的事实与指针，不抄录或另立规矩；查规矩回现行真源，查共用记忆只当资料，不冒认为本窗经历。
为什么: 混用共同资料与本窗经历会造成误记和规矩冲突，应分清权威依据、本窗事实与参考资料。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Memory does not establish rules
text: Memory holds facts and pointers within the window's responsibilities, not copied or newly established rules. Read current authorities for rules and treat shared memory as reference material rather than personal experience.
rationale: Separate authoritative rules, this window's facts, and reference material to avoid false memories and conflicting rules.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 一页入口亲读现行任务
条文: 主窗入口≤1页，列身份、职责、禁区与现行依据指针；依次读入口、{{规矩总件}}、{{作业件}}和本次任务。执行窗通读任务书、交接件，不以摘要代替；临时子代理读指定依据，历史按需查，压缩后重读现行依据。
为什么: 控制入口体积不是省略执行依据；源项目经验。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Keep a one-page entry and read active assignments
text: Keep the main-window entry at most one page, naming identity, responsibilities, exclusions, and current-authority pointers. Read entry, {{规矩总件}}, {{作业件}}, and the current task in order. Execution windows read complete assignments and handovers rather than summaries. Temporary helpers read named authorities; consult history as needed and reread active authorities after compaction.
rationale: Limiting entry size does not justify omitting execution authorities; this reflects experience in the source project.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 上下文按责任分层
条文: 执行窗(若设)加载任务记录，位主加载本位职责与任务，{{总协调}}加载{{规矩总件}}与全局概览；不把各层资料全部塞进每个窗。
为什么: 防止每窗都加载无关层级资料(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Layer context by responsibility
text: Execution windows, if any, load task records; role owners load their responsibilities and task; {{总协调}} loads {{规矩总件}} and the global overview. Do not put every level's materials into every window.
rationale: Prevent unrelated organizational context from filling every window, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 长文先搜再读
条文: 历史与长篇参考先搜再读相关段；发现整读长文就改搜索。任务书、交接件仍由执行窗完整通读。
为什么: 防止整读长文挤占任务上下文(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Search long references before reading
text: Search historical and lengthy reference material before reading relevant passages. Switch to search if reading an entire long reference. Execution windows still read complete current assignments and handovers.
rationale: Prevent whole-reference reading from consuming task context, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 设续作记录事件即更新
条文: {{接管件}}记现状、未完、在跑助手与下一步，派出、交回或要求变更即更新，可与现有记录合放。范围外问题只记位置、待办，不复抄；换窗不算完成，确认下窗能续办，未完或助手在跑不报做完。
为什么: 状态及时保存，不靠压缩前补记，不把换窗冒充完成。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Update continuation records on events
text: {{接管件}} records current state, unfinished work, running helpers, and next steps; update on dispatch, return, or requirement changes and combine with existing records if useful. Record only locations and remaining work for out-of-scope issues. Window replacement is not completion: ensure the next window can continue, and never claim completion with work or helpers still active.
rationale: Save state promptly rather than reconstructing it before compaction or calling a window replacement completion.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 共用记忆索引归口
条文: 共用记忆索引由{{总协调}}统一维护，每个分工位只留一个入口；本位现状与任务写回{{接管件}}，不在索引再列一套。
为什么: 防止共用索引另存一套过期现状(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Centralize shared-memory indexing
text: {{总协调}} maintains the shared-memory index centrally; each role keeps one entry. Put local state and tasks in {{接管件}} rather than another state list in the index.
rationale: Prevent shared indexes from retaining a second obsolete current-state copy, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 小中项目轻量核记忆
条文: 中规模时，共用记忆新件标临时与到期日，默认7天；负责窗核出处、语义、重复项后决定转长期，不另设岗。到期未转则移出共用记忆，原件留存。
为什么: 记忆不能各窗各存一条而不断累积；少量共用记忆由责任窗直接核。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Review medium-project memory lightly
text: At medium scale, mark new shared-memory items temporary with a seven-day default expiry. The responsible window checks sources, meaning, and duplicates before making them permanent, without a new role. Remove unpromoted expired items from shared memory while retaining originals.
rationale: Shared memory must not grow by independent additions from every window; small amounts can be checked directly by the owner.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 共用记忆转长期分层审
条文: 共用记忆新件先临时保存7天；若已设审查席，由其核来源、含义和重复内容，再交{{总协调}}确认转长期；未设时由现有负责人核实，不另增岗位。到期未转的移出共用记忆，原件留存。
为什么: 先临时保存再核实转长期，防止每窗各添一条而让长期内容不断累积。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Review permanent shared memory by responsibility
text: Keep new shared-memory items temporary for seven days. If a review role exists, it checks sources, meaning, and duplicates before {{总协调}} confirms permanent inclusion; otherwise existing owners verify without creating roles. Remove unpromoted expired items from shared memory while retaining originals.
rationale: Temporary storage followed by verification prevents unchecked long-term growth from every window's additions.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 子代理临界交接接力
条文: 子代理上下文接近约定的可用上限时，交回已有结果与交接件，另派新子代理读交接件续办，不靠旧上下文一直硬撑。
为什么: 防止上下文耗尽导致接力断线(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Hand over helpers near context limits
text: When a helper approaches its agreed usable context limit, return existing results and a handover. Assign a fresh helper to continue from it rather than relying indefinitely on the old context.
rationale: Prevent context exhaustion from breaking the relay, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 位主不是事前审批人
条文: 位主不是审批人；其他分工位在本位改动面内做可回退的最小修复，无须事前请准，相关位主回窗不同意则回退。
为什么: 防止可回退小修被事前审批挡住(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Role owners are not prior approvers
text: Role owners are not approvers. Other roles may make minimal reversible fixes within the owner's change area without prior permission; revert if the relevant owner disagrees on returning.
rationale: Prevent prior approval from blocking small reversible fixes, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 跨位先对口再升级
条文: 依赖、改动交叉、结论冲突或边界疑问，由相关在岗窗当回合直接对齐，各在{{留痕处}}记一行，不等人来、不经{{总协调}}转述；谈不拢再请协调。对方离线时，非红线且授权内可回退项留痕照推荐先做，答后调整。
为什么: 有关联的工作先由双方直接沟通，避免等待、反复转述和理解失真。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Coordinate directly before escalation
text: Relevant active windows align dependencies, overlapping changes, conflicting conclusions, and scope questions in the same turn, each recording one line in {{留痕处}}. Do not wait for contact or relay through {{总协调}}; ask for coordination only if agreement fails. If the other party is offline, record authorized reversible actions outside exceptions, follow the recommendation, and adjust after a reply.
rationale: Direct communication avoids waiting, repeated relays, and misunderstandings in related work.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 记录手续出错不拖住成果
条文: 交全约定成果；先交样本须预告样本与余量。不影响使用的记录格式、路径写法、副本更新问题记{{留痕处}}由负责人补正，不停其他工作；缺必要依据、接不上或成果未达标仍处理。
为什么: 不能把等审或非业务手续变成停工前置，真实业务问题仍须处理。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Record procedural corrections without blocking outputs
text: Deliver all agreed outputs; announce samples and remaining volume before partial delivery. Record harmless record-format, path-notation, and copy-update issues in {{留痕处}} for the owner to correct without stopping other work. Still address missing necessary authority, broken integration, and unmet outputs.
rationale: Pending review and nonbusiness procedure must not become work-stoppage prerequisites, while real business defects still need repair.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 跨位挡活只做可回退小修
条文: 范围外真缺陷挡本位且已有推荐，可做最小可回退修，记双方{{留痕处}}；位主不同意则退。约定类或无推荐的交位主，不代选方案。
为什么: 防止挡活久等或越权代选方案(源项目经验)
加回条件: 写程序时加回。
title: Keep cross-role blocking fixes minimal and reversible
text: If a real out-of-scope defect blocks local work and a recommendation exists, make the smallest reversible repair and record it in both parties' {{留痕处}}; revert if the owner disagrees. Refer agreed-design questions or cases without recommendations to the owner rather than choosing for them.
rationale: Prevent prolonged blocking waits and unauthorized choices on another role's behalf, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when programming starts.

短题: 变更按影响面送达
条文: 已派任务的口径、默认来源或在用指针变更，送达受影响位并记{{留痕处}}；需承接时按模块指明责任，不摊无关模块。仅本位留言不算送达，不广播无关窗。
为什么: 防止只记本位却误当已送达(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Notify only affected parties of changes
text: Deliver changes to dispatched-task requirements, defaults, or active pointers to affected roles and record them in {{留痕处}}. Name module ownership when uptake is needed rather than distributing unrelated work. A local note alone is not delivery; do not broadcast unrelated windows.
rationale: Prevent local records from being mistaken for delivered notifications, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 接口约定交可接用的材料
条文: 分工之间确定代码接口时，按约定技术和交付时间提供对方可接用、可核对的接口说明或最小实现，例如接口定义、调用样例或空实现；交到约定位置并告知使用方。不统一要求当天交分支，也不把尚未交出的约定报成已经可用。
为什么: 防止口头约定被当可用接口(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Deliver usable interface materials
text: For inter-role code interfaces, supply usable, verifiable documentation or a minimum implementation using the agreed technology and timing, such as definitions, examples, or a stub. Deliver it to the agreed location and notify consumers. Do not require same-day branches universally or describe undelivered agreements as available.
rationale: Prevent verbal agreements from being treated as usable interfaces, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 共享依赖任务排先后
条文: 代码任务若同改配置或脚本、量测基线相依，或依赖未集成成果，须合单或排先后，不并行开工。
为什么: 防止共享修改与依赖并行相撞(源项目经验)
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Order tasks sharing changes or dependencies
text: Merge or sequence code tasks that change the same configuration or scripts, depend on measurement baselines, or rely on unintegrated outputs; do not start them in parallel.
rationale: Prevent collisions from shared edits or dependency-parallel execution, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 同文件冲突原位合成
条文: 同一分工位的多项代码任务修改同一文件时，由原位先合成一份交付；集成只做机械合并，语义分歧退回原位处理，不由集成方代判。
为什么: 防止集成方擅定语义或漏合内容(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Resolve same-file conflicts in the owning role
text: When several tasks under one role edit the same file, that role combines them before delivery. Integration performs mechanical merging only; send semantic disagreements back to the owner rather than letting integration decide.
rationale: Prevent integration from deciding semantics or losing changes, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 无推送通道主动查收
条文: 开工与集成前，在本位{{留痕处}}各报告一次改动面，并主动查收协作记录；没有推送的通道，不查收就不算完成传达，写下消息不等于对方已收到。
为什么: 通道没有推送，写了消息不等于对方收到
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Check channels that do not push notifications
text: Report change scope once in the role's {{留痕处}} at startup and again before integration, actively checking collaboration records. On channels without push, a message is not delivered until checked; writing is not receipt.
rationale: Without push notification, a written message does not establish that its recipient received it.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 范围外问题登记转交
条文: 范围外问题记现象、位置、可能负责人，交{{总协调}}或现有负责人，不顺手追修；不预设运维岗或当天派单期限。约定须立即处理的优先办，挡本任务的跨位小修仍须已有授权。
为什么: 防止范围外缺陷无人接或被顺手扩修(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Register and refer out-of-scope issues
text: Record symptoms, location, and likely owner for out-of-scope issues and refer them to {{总协调}} or an existing owner without incidental repair. Do not assume an operations role or a same-day dispatch deadline. Handle explicitly urgent issues first; cross-role repairs blocking current work still require authorization.
rationale: Prevent unowned external defects and incidental scope expansion, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 共用素材参数单一负责
条文: 影响多个分工位的共用素材参数，由一个分工位负责修改；改前在{{留痕处}}通知受影响分工位。
为什么: 防止多人同时改共用参数互相覆盖(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有素材时加回。
title: Give shared asset parameters one owner
text: One role changes asset parameters affecting several roles. Notify affected roles through {{留痕处}} before editing.
rationale: Prevent simultaneous shared-parameter changes from overwriting one another, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: assets.

短题: 源件改到素材才通知重做
条文: 派生素材记录生成所用的{{真源件}}版本及相关字段。只有改到了影响该素材内容或生成结果的字段，改动方才在{{留痕处}}通知素材负责人重做受影响部分；无关选题、标点或未使用字段变化，不要求整批重做。
为什么: 防止派生素材漏随相关源字段更新(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序，且有素材时加回。
title: Regenerate assets only for relevant source changes
text: Derived assets record the {{真源件}} version and relevant fields used for generation. Notify the asset owner in {{留痕处}} to regenerate affected parts only when changes affect asset content or output. Unrelated topics, punctuation, and unused fields do not require full regeneration.
rationale: Prevent derived assets from missing updates to relevant source fields, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts) and assets are involved.

短题: 跨位修复回执通知报缺方
条文: 修复其他分工位报送的代码缺陷后，留下修复回执，并在{{留痕处}}通知报缺方。
为什么: 防止已修复却未告知报缺方(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Notify reporters after cross-role repairs
text: After fixing a code defect reported by another role, leave a repair receipt and notify the reporter through {{留痕处}}.
rationale: Prevent reporters from remaining unaware of completed repairs, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 冻结接口与边界明示
条文: 职责说明须列明对外冻结的代码接口与分工边界，不得擅改冻结接口；跨位改动须有任务授权，或符合挡活缺陷的可回退最小修例外。
为什么: 防止冻结接口被擅改而破坏协作(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: State frozen interfaces and scope explicitly
text: Responsibilities list externally frozen interfaces and role limits. Do not change frozen interfaces without authority. Cross-role changes require task authorization or the permitted exception for minimal reversible repairs of blocking defects.
rationale: Prevent unauthorized frozen-interface changes from breaking collaboration, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 负责人离线按现有授权接手
条文: 代码负责人不在岗时，若已指定接手人就按授权承接；未指定则由现有负责人安排，不强设常驻代班岗位。恢复工作先读{{接管件}}和相关{{留痕处}}再继续。
为什么: 防止负责人离线后缺陷无人承接(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Take over offline owners under existing authority
text: If an offline code owner has a designated replacement, take over under that authorization; otherwise an existing owner arranges coverage without a mandatory permanent deputy. Read {{接管件}} and relevant {{留痕处}} before resuming.
rationale: Prevent defects from becoming unowned when an owner is offline, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 共享设备按实占排队
条文: 若共用设备确需排他占用，按申请顺序和实际开始时间协调，不因预定钟点打断在做的任务；尚未占用时照常工作，占用间隙可做不冲突的短任务。没有共享独占设备时不另建排队或批次制度。
为什么: 实际开工时间难保证，固定钟点让机会打断在途工作；设备避让只针对真实占用冲突。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4）时加回。
title: Queue shared devices by actual occupancy
text: When shared equipment genuinely requires exclusive use, coordinate by request order and actual start time rather than interrupting work at a reserved clock time. Continue normal work before occupancy and do nonconflicting short tasks between uses. Do not create queues or batches without shared exclusive equipment.
rationale: Actual start times vary; coordination addresses real device conflicts rather than interrupting active work according to optimistic schedules.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4.

短题: 不同项目资源互相隔离
条文: 不同项目的目录、端口与凭据互不读写，不擅自升级系统级工具链；凭据问题按各自代码远端分别修复，不跨项目改动。
为什么: 防止跨项目误写资源或共用环境(源项目经验)
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Isolate resources between projects
text: Do not read or write another project's directories, ports, or credentials, or upgrade system toolchains without authority. Repair credential issues separately for each project's remote, without cross-project changes.
rationale: Prevent accidental cross-project resource or shared-environment changes, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 推送归口且不强推
条文: 有分工位协作时，远端推送由约定的分工位负责，执行窗(若设)不自行推送，不使用强制推送。
为什么: 防止越权推送或强推覆盖远端(源项目经验)
加回条件: 写程序时加回。
title: Centralize pushes and never force-push
text: In multi-role collaboration, the agreed role owns remote pushes. Execution windows, if any, do not push independently or use force-push.
rationale: Prevent unauthorized pushes or overwriting remote history, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when programming starts.

短题: 公开仓推送先获授权
条文: 向公开代码仓推送变更前，须取得{{决策者}}的明确授权。
为什么: 防止未授权就对外公开变更(源项目经验)
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Get authorization before public pushes
text: Obtain explicit authorization from {{决策者}} before pushing changes to a public repository.
rationale: Prevent public disclosure of changes without authorization, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 首次公开扫描完整历史
条文: 代码仓首次公开推送按对外发布处理；扫描完整历史中的密钥及内部路径、内部文书、内部人名，确认相关命中为零后再公开。
为什么: 公开仓库历史可能连带泄露秘密和内部资料，不能只检查当前文件。
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Scan full history before first publication
text: Treat a repository's first public push as external publication. Scan its entire history for secrets and internal paths, documents, and personal names; publish only after confirming zero relevant findings.
rationale: Repository history can leak secrets and internal material even when current files are clean.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 核心规则隔离环境依赖
条文: 核心规则计算层只保留纯函数，不读取全局状态，不直接取时或取随机数，也不引用承载运行环境的实现层；环境相关代码留在规则层之外。
为什么: 防止环境状态渗入核心规则计算(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码、数值时加回。
title: Keep environment dependencies outside core rules
text: Core rule calculations use pure functions without global-state reads, direct clock or randomness reads, or imports from runtime-environment implementations. Keep environment-specific code outside the rule layer.
rationale: Prevent environment state from leaking into core rule calculations, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code, values.

短题: 提交推送按任务授权
条文: 本次未明确授权不提交、不推送，改码不含该授权。仅暂存、分阶段独立提交本任务白名单；每次显式限文件，共享文件只交本任务行键，不夹带他人或他项改动。
为什么: 防止越权提交或夹带其他任务改动(源项目经验)
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Commit and push only as authorized
text: Do not commit or push without explicit current-task authorization; code editing does not imply it. Stage and make independent phase commits only for the task's allowlist. Limit files explicitly each time; commit only owned lines and keys in shared files without others' or other tasks' changes.
rationale: Prevent unauthorized commits and unrelated changes from entering them, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 界面交付验证真实主流程
条文: 可操作界面交付须构建，并在真实运行环境验证{{受众}}实际会用的流程，不以只为判卷制作的产出代替。
为什么: 只为判卷存在的产出不应成为交付负担；验证要落到{{受众}}真正会操作的路径，而不是另造验收材料。
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Verify actual interface workflows
text: Build interactive interfaces before delivery and verify the workflows {{受众}} actually uses in the real runtime. Outputs made solely for grading are not a substitute.
rationale: Verification belongs on real user paths rather than introducing artifacts that exist only for grading.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 交互按键不在代码写死
条文: 交互按键、快捷键统一经配置入口读取，不在代码写死；入口依项目技术选定，不要求程序读取说明文档。
为什么: 防止改键后仍触发代码写死的旧键(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Read interaction keys from configuration
text: Read interaction keys and shortcuts through one configuration entry rather than hardcoding them. Choose that entry for the project's technology; programs need not read explanatory documents.
rationale: Prevent obsolete hardcoded keys from still firing after reconfiguration, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 运营数值集中可调
条文: 运营中可能调整且{{受众}}可感知的数值，集中在参数表或具名单一入口；使用方读取统一下发值，编译期常量只作缺省兜底，小幅调整不要求重新分发{{成品}}。
为什么: 运营期的小幅数值调整不应牵动{{成品}}重新分发；统一下发值才是实际取值，编译常量只负责缺省兜底。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码、上线、数值时加回。
title: Centralize adjustable operational values
text: Keep values that may change during operation and affect {{受众}} in a parameter table or named single entry. Consumers read centrally distributed values; compile-time constants are fallback defaults only. Small changes do not require redistributing {{成品}}.
rationale: Operational tuning should not force redistribution; distributed values are authoritative while compiled constants supply defaults only.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code, deployment, values.

短题: 推送失败先核远端
条文: 推送失败时，先核对远端实际状态，再如实回报，不仅凭本地命令结果认定远端结果。
为什么: 防止本地报错被误当远端未变(源项目经验)
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Check remote state after push failures
text: After a push failure, inspect actual remote state before reporting truthfully. Do not infer remote results solely from the local command's result.
rationale: Prevent local errors from being mistaken for an unchanged remote, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 实现偏离就地说明
条文: 实现与既定文档存在偏离时，在相应代码处标明偏离及原因。
为什么: 防止实现偏离文档却无法追因(源项目经验)
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Explain implementation deviations locally
text: When implementation differs from established documentation, identify the deviation and its reason at the corresponding code location.
rationale: Prevent unexplained implementation deviations from becoming untraceable, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 生产镜像刷新按行为验证
条文: 被生产实现当作{{真源件}}解析的下游镜像，一经刷新就属于行为改动，须按行为改动验证，不得仅按数据搬运处理。
为什么: 镜像内容会被生产实现直接解析，刷新它就会影响实际行为，不能因文件名义上是镜像而省掉行为验证。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Verify production-mirror refreshes as behavior
text: A downstream mirror parsed as {{真源件}} by production code changes behavior when refreshed. Verify it as a behavior change rather than treating it only as data movement.
rationale: Production directly parses mirror contents, so refreshing a nominal mirror affects behavior and cannot skip behavioral verification.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 依据读取约定权威版本
条文: 起草、派遣与核实所用底数，读取约定共享基线或指定权威版本，不用工作区未定改动、未合并副本代替；派子代理时写明同一要求。
为什么: 防止未定工作区改动被当权威底数(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Read the agreed authoritative revision
text: Read drafting, dispatch, and verification values from the agreed shared baseline or named authoritative revision, not unsettled workspace edits or unmerged copies. Give helpers the same requirement.
rationale: Prevent unsettled workspace changes from becoming authoritative baseline values, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 解冲突保留双方所需改动
条文: 解冲突只按任务改本单内容，他人内容原样保留、不代修，双方所需均不丢；解完构建并通过双方相关测试。
为什么: 防止解冲突丢改动或误修他人内容(源项目经验)
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Preserve both parties' required conflict changes
text: Resolve only the task's content during conflicts, preserving others' content unchanged without incidental repairs and retaining all required changes from both sides. Build afterward and pass both parties' relevant tests.
rationale: Prevent conflict resolution from losing changes or repairing unrelated content, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 行为变更保留回归覆盖
条文: 每项业务行为变更配最少1条行为断言；旧测因本单确认的新行为失败只改期望，不删测试；断言钉行为不钉格式。
为什么: 防止行为改动无覆盖或删旧测掩错(源项目经验)
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Keep regression assertions for behavior changes
text: Each business-behavior change has at least one behavior assertion. If an old test fails because of the task's confirmed new behavior, update expectations rather than deleting the test. Pin behavior, not formatting.
rationale: Prevent untested behavior changes and deleted tests that hide defects, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 先查已有能力再自建
条文: 确定实现方案前，核对是否在手工补造现有工具已提供的功能；先对标成熟做法，再决定需要自行实现的部分。
为什么: 防止把工具本来就有的功能误当缺口，再手工补造一套。
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Check existing capabilities before rebuilding
text: Before choosing an implementation, check whether existing tools already provide the capability being rebuilt manually. Compare mature approaches before deciding what needs custom implementation.
rationale: Prevent existing tool capabilities from being misidentified as gaps and rebuilt manually.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 提交身份不扰共享配置
条文: 需要独立提交身份时，使用仅对本次命令或独立工作副本生效的设置，不修改多人共用的身份配置；署名按本项目既定约定，不预设必须使用岗位名，也不为换身份改写已有提交。
为什么: 防止个人提交身份污染共享配置(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Keep commit identity out of shared configuration
text: When a separate commit identity is needed, use settings limited to the current command or isolated working copy rather than shared identity configuration. Follow established project attribution, without assuming role-name authorship or rewriting commits to change identity.
rationale: Prevent individual commit identity from contaminating shared configuration, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 合并与解冲突明确交接
条文: 合并、构建、测试和处理冲突由任务约定的负责人或获授权助手执行，不强制主窗与助手固定分工。交接时给出待合内容、冲突位置、双方应保留的改动及已做检查，接手者可以更换；不借合并改无关代码或增加交付手续。
为什么: 防止合并交接不清或借机改无关代码(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Hand over merge and conflict work explicitly
text: The agreed owner or authorized helper performs merges, builds, tests, and conflict resolution; no fixed main/helper split is required. Handovers identify pending changes, conflicts, changes each side must retain, and completed checks; the next executor may differ. Do not modify unrelated code or add procedures through merging.
rationale: Prevent unclear merge handovers and unrelated changes made during integration, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 各自查局部合齐后查整体
条文: 开发窗仅构建、测试所改模块；合齐后现有整合负责人全工程构建1次，跑任务点名测试，不另设子代理岗。同区不并发构建；内容与使用条件同则复用，修后仅复验失败项。
为什么: 同一工作区并发构建会撞中间产物；分头只做局部检查，最终组合后集中验证，避免重复全工程构建。
加回条件: 写程序时加回。
title: Check locally, then check the assembled result
text: Development windows build and test only modified modules. After assembly, the existing integration owner builds the complete project once and runs the assignment's named tests without adding a role. Do not build concurrently in the same workspace. Reuse results under unchanged conditions; after repair recheck failed items only.
rationale: Concurrent builds collide on intermediates; local checks followed by one assembled check avoid duplicate full builds.
restore_condition: Restore when programming starts.

短题: 小项目集中验证最终改动
条文: 小规模时，负责窗收齐最终改动，统一构建并跑本次点名测试1次；不另设合并岗，同区不并发构建。
为什么: 集中验证最终改动，避免同区中间产物冲突和重复构建。
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Verify final small-project changes centrally
text: At small scale, the responsible window collects final changes, builds, and runs named tests once. No separate merge role is required and builds do not run concurrently in one workspace.
rationale: Central final verification avoids intermediate-artifact conflicts and repeated builds.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 代码规范统一自检
条文: 工程代码与辅助工具同受已定代码规范约束，不因用途或目录自行豁免；构建后执行约定的规范检查，在{{留痕处}}记录退出结果，自检不额外变成交付闸。
为什么: 防止辅助工具被擅自豁免代码规范(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Apply code conventions to tools too
text: Project code and auxiliary tools follow established code conventions without self-exemptions by purpose or directory. After building, run agreed convention checks and record exit results in {{留痕处}}; self-checking does not become an additional delivery checkpoint.
rationale: Prevent auxiliary tools from being exempted from coding standards without authority, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 存量失败清理错峰
条文: 清理存量测试失败不与其他改动批量并行；待该批集成完成、目标分支静止后单独处理。已在执行的清理任务按已取得的组合版本收口，不追逐新合入改动。
为什么: 边集成边清理会不断改变目标版本；清理窗应按已取得的组合结果结束，不追着后来合入的改动跑。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Schedule existing-failure cleanup separately
text: Do not run bulk existing-test-failure cleanup alongside other changes. Wait until the batch is integrated and the target branch is stationary. Already active cleanup tasks finish against the acquired combined revision rather than chasing later integrations.
rationale: Concurrent integration and cleanup constantly move the target; cleanup should finish against its acquired combination.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 共享集成只等实际依赖
条文: 合入共享分支只等本任务的实际前置改动，不排队等无关任务。若多人会同时改写同一分支或中间产物，采用本项目已定的隔离或短时互斥办法，不能把“不等无关任务”理解为可互相覆盖；在确定的组合版本上按任务构建和验证。
为什么: 真正需协调的是前置依赖和同一共享状态的写入冲突，无关任务不应拖住交付。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Wait only for actual integration dependencies
text: Integration into a shared branch waits only for actual prerequisites, not unrelated tasks. If several people can write the same branch or intermediate artifacts, use established isolation or brief mutual exclusion; not waiting for unrelated tasks does not permit overwrites. Build and verify the determined combination as assigned.
rationale: Coordination is needed for prerequisites and shared-state writes, not unrelated work.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 工作副本随任务退役
条文: 创建工作副本的分工位负责收回，副本随任务结束退役；为导入与验证生成的缓存、拷贝等派生物不作交付物，也随任务收回。
为什么: 防止任务结束仍堆留工作副本与派生物(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Retire working copies with their tasks
text: The role creating a working copy owns its retirement when the task ends. Derived caches and copies generated for import or verification are not deliverables and retire with it.
rationale: Prevent work copies and derived artifacts from remaining after tasks end, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 独立审计读取候选版本
条文: 独立代码审计以本次候选提交的差异及该提交内文件为准，不用当前工作区代替；共享内容只核本次声称改动的行与键。
为什么: 防止审计工作区而非实际候选版本(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Audit the candidate revision independently
text: Independent code audits use differences and files in the current candidate commit, not the current workspace. For shared content inspect only the lines and keys claimed by this task.
rationale: Prevent auditing a workspace instead of the actual candidate revision, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 本次评价不混入既有问题
条文: 评价代码变更的卫生状况时，只统计本次变更相对基点的差异，不把既有问题计作本次引入。
为什么: 防止把既有卫生问题算作本次引入(源项目经验)
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Separate current changes from existing issues
text: Evaluate code-change hygiene by differences from the starting baseline only. Do not count pre-existing issues as introduced by the current task.
rationale: Prevent existing hygiene issues from being attributed to the current change, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 通用能力与专属数据分层
条文: 可复用能力与项目专属数据分层：通用代码不包含项目内容或密钥，专属数据独立私有保存；对外共享只交付通用部分。
为什么: 可复用能力和项目专属内容分层，防止复用时连带交出私有内容或秘密。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Separate reusable capabilities and private data
text: Layer reusable capabilities separately from project-specific data. General code contains no project content or secrets; keep specific data private and separate, sharing only the general portion externally.
rationale: Separating reusable capability from project content prevents accidental disclosure of private material and secrets.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 共用检出不挪动共享状态
条文: 在共用检出协作时，不从副本提交，不移植提交、变基、藏起共享改动、重置状态或改写提交；不得用整理本位改动的操作挪动他人的共享状态。
为什么: 防止整理自己改动时挪坏共享状态(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Do not move shared checkout state
text: In a shared checkout, do not commit from copies, transplant commits, rebase, hide shared edits, reset state, or rewrite commits. Organizing local changes must not move another person's shared state.
rationale: Prevent local change organization from damaging shared state, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 发布授权不附带生产指挥
条文: 若项目已单独设置合并发布负责人，其职责按授权承接打包、分发和上线，不因能发布就取得生产指挥或独立验收的裁定权，也不擅自接手他人在办任务。没有专职发布岗位时，由现有获授权人员承担，不强制把开发与发布分为两个岗位。
为什么: 防止发布权限被当成生产或验收指挥权(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码、上线时加回。
title: Release authority does not grant production command
text: If a separate merge/release owner exists, its authorization covers packaging, distribution, and deployment, not production command or independent acceptance rulings, nor takeover of active work without authority. Otherwise existing authorized people release without mandatory separation between development and release roles.
rationale: Prevent release permissions from being mistaken for production or acceptance command, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code, deployment.

短题: 开发交付与上线权限分清
条文: 任务明示只交版本或已授权上线；上线、重启、在线权限变更仅授权者依既定流程做。现有开发、测试负责人可承担，不预设运维或批次发布岗；未授权只交约定成果。
为什么: 防止只获交版授权却擅自操作生产(源项目经验)
加回条件: 写程序且上线时加回。
title: Separate development delivery and deployment rights
text: Assignments explicitly state version-only delivery or authorized deployment. Only authorized people deploy, restart, or change live permissions through established procedures. Existing development or testing owners may do so; assume no operations or batch-release role. Without authority, deliver only agreed outputs.
rationale: Prevent production operations after authorization only to deliver a version, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when programming and deployment are involved.

短题: 发布检查不得绕过
条文: 发布前执行既定检查与参数自检，不跳过测试，也不删减检查来绕过失败结果。
为什么: 防止跳过既定检查把失败版本发布(源项目经验)
加回条件: 写程序且上线时加回。
title: Never bypass release checks
text: Run established checks and parameter self-checks before release. Do not skip tests or remove checks to bypass failures.
rationale: Prevent releasing failed versions by skipping established checks, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when programming and deployment are involved.

短题: 发布失败按可回退性处理
条文: 构建或发布检查失败即停发，不跳失败推送；已部署服务端能当场安全替换才退上一可用部署。用户手中客户端不假报整体即时回退，应停推、下版修复并说明实际结果。
为什么: 防止失败仍推送或虚报已安全回退(源项目经验)
加回条件: 写程序且上线时加回。
title: Handle release failures according to reversibility
text: Stop release when builds or release checks fail; do not push past failures. Revert a deployed server only when it can be replaced safely immediately. Do not claim instantaneous rollback of clients already held by users; stop distribution, fix the next version, and state actual results.
rationale: Prevent pushes after failure or false claims of safe rollback, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when programming and deployment are involved.

短题: 采用批次才按截止排期
条文: 若项目已决定按批次发布，就按公布的截止时间执行，未就绪任务转下一批，不临时等候或反复询问已公布时间；采用按需发布的项目按自己的发布约定执行，不额外建立固定批次。
为什么: 防止未就绪任务拖住既定发布批次(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有上线时加回。
title: Use batch cutoffs only for batch releases
text: If batch releases are chosen, follow published cutoffs and move unready tasks to the next batch without ad hoc waiting or repeated questions about published times. On-demand projects follow their own release arrangements without an extra fixed batch system.
rationale: Prevent unready tasks from delaying an established release batch, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: deployment.

短题: 共用发布工具核常规用法
条文: 改共用发布工具，核实不带本任务专用设置的常规发布仍原样通过并留证，说明对其他任务发布的影响；由本次责任窗执行，已有独立审计则核证据，不为此另加一道。未改共用工具不扩查，不另设发布前置审批。
为什么: 防止专用设置掩盖共用发布路径受损(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码、上线时加回。
title: Check ordinary usage of shared release tools
text: After changing shared release tools, verify ordinary release without task-specific settings still passes unchanged and retain evidence. Explain effects on other releases. The current responsible window performs this; existing independent audits inspect evidence without an additional audit. Without tool changes, do not expand checking or add prior approvals.
rationale: Prevent task-specific settings from hiding damage to shared release paths, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code, deployment.

短题: 风格参考不混入生产素材
条文: 可用外部成品图作风格锚点给生成工具参考；参考件单独存放，不混入正式素材，不因获准参考就把他方原始素材纳入{{项目名}}。
为什么: 借外部作品标定审美，不是抄入其素材。
加回条件: 批量做≥1类素材时加回。
title: Keep style references separate from production assets
text: External finished images may guide generation style. Store references separately from production assets; permission to reference does not authorize inclusion of another party's original assets in {{项目名}}.
rationale: External work can establish aesthetic direction without copying its assets.
restore_condition: Restore when producing at least one type of asset in bulk.

短题: 设素材清单记录生成版本
条文: 用1份素材清单记位置、来源、实核数量、工作用或正式用或已停用，以及{{成品}}使用位置，未核不填已确认。派生素材记依据版本和相关字段；只有影响内容或生成结果的字段改变才标更新，不因无关改动整批重做。
为什么: 素材先归类，工作件不混正式件，派生物随源更新。
加回条件: 批量做≥1类素材时加回。
title: Record asset inventory and generation versions
text: Use one inventory for locations, sources, verified counts, working/production/retired status, and use in {{成品}}; do not mark unverified claims confirmed. Derived assets record source versions and relevant fields. Mark updates only when those fields affect content or results, not for unrelated full regeneration.
rationale: Classify assets, separate working from production files, and update derivatives with their sources.
restore_condition: Restore when producing at least one type of asset in bulk.

短题: 素材清单明确一人维护
条文: 由现有协作者中一名明确负责人维护当前素材清单，不强制新增素材管理岗位；其他人交文件位置和来源，由约定入口更新。职责说明只给清单位置，旧盘点标作历史，不把当前数量复制到多份文件。
为什么: 旧盘点不是现库存，现值多处复抄会不同步；源项目经验。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序，且有素材时加回。
title: Give the asset inventory one owner
text: One named existing collaborator maintains the current asset inventory without a mandatory new asset-management role. Others supply file locations and sources through the agreed entry. Responsibilities link its location; mark old inventories historical and do not copy current counts into multiple documents.
rationale: Old inventories are not current stock, and copied current values drift; this reflects experience in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts) and assets are involved.

短题: 素材来源与用途能查到
条文: 新素材在统一清单登记来源和使用位置，实际用于{{成品}}的文件逐件能查到原始来源。若制作和整理已分给不同人，就按约定交接；同一人兼任时自行登记核对即可，不要求另一岗位批准后才算交付。
为什么: 将实际使用的素材与个人资料分清，并保留来源和使用位置，才能追查是否用错文件；登记不应变成额外审批。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序，且有素材时加回。
title: Keep asset sources and uses traceable
text: Register new asset sources and use locations centrally, tracing each file actually used in {{成品}} to its original source. Follow agreed handovers if production and organization have different owners; a single owner records and verifies independently without another role's approval as a prerequisite.
rationale: Separate actual production assets from personal material and keep sources traceable without turning registration into extra approval.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts) and assets are involved.

短题: 素材输入先归入在用区
条文: 批量压缩、打包或交付前,核输入已归入在用区并列入现行清单;新生成的素材先登记进清单再往下处理,登记这一步本身不受此限;不直接调用个人资料或退役件。
为什么: 个人资料先规范归位；仍被成品或生产读取的旧件也不能清理走。
加回条件: 批量做≥1类素材时加回。
title: Register asset inputs before processing
text: Before bulk compression, packaging, or delivery, check inputs are active and included in the current inventory. Register newly generated assets before further processing; registration itself is exempt from that prerequisite. Do not consume personal reference material or retired files directly.
rationale: Personal material needs proper placement first, while old files still used by production cannot be removed.
restore_condition: Restore when producing at least one type of asset in bulk.

短题: 退役素材保留还原索引
条文: 素材移入退役区时保留还原索引，记录退役前后位置的对应关系，使退役件仍能追溯还原。
为什么: 防止素材退役后找不到原位还原(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序，且有素材时加回。
title: Keep restoration indexes for retired assets
text: When retiring assets, retain a restoration index mapping old and new locations so retired files remain traceable and restorable.
rationale: Prevent retired assets from losing their original restoration locations, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts) and assets are involved.

短题: 素材入仓只收交付件
条文: 若代码仓已约定只保存运行交付用素材，就只提交约定格式的交付件和出处，源工程、候选件和渲染中间件留在约定的仓外归档位置；若另有素材源工程仓或需共同编辑，按该仓既定收录规则，不一律排除源件。
为什么: 防止中间源件混入只收运行交付件的仓(源项目经验)
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓且批量做≥1类素材时加回。
title: Commit only agreed deliverable assets
text: If a repository is designated for runtime/delivery assets only, commit only agreed delivery formats and sources. Keep source projects, candidates, and render intermediates in the agreed external archive. If a separate source-asset repository or joint editing is required, follow that repository's inclusion rules rather than universally excluding sources.
rationale: Prevent intermediate source files from entering repositories intended only for runtime delivery, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository and producing at least one asset type in bulk.

短题: 定调未过不铺量
条文: 若已约定一批素材先确认风格，就先交样本，得到{{决策者}}或其明确授权者确认并记下结果，再批量制作；暂停哪些内容、何时恢复由{{决策者}}明确。未采用这种安排的项目不另建冻结流程。
为什么: 防止风格未确认就批量制作而返工(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序，且有素材时加回。
title: Confirm style before batch production
text: If a batch requires style confirmation first, deliver a sample, obtain and record confirmation from {{决策者}} or an explicitly authorized person, then produce in bulk. {{决策者}} specifies what pauses and when it resumes. Do not add a freeze process to projects without this arrangement.
rationale: Prevent batch production before style approval and resulting rework, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts) and assets are involved.

短题: 审美只按明确授权决定
条文: 素材取向由{{决策者}}决定；若已明确授权他人，就由授权者统一说明风格和参考样本，并保留授权及确认记录，不因此强设审美、执行、协调三个岗位。制作者按确认要求制作；文件规格、能否看清和能否用于{{成品}}另行检查，技术自查通过不能冒充审美获批，审美返工不另设次数上限。
为什么: 若{{决策者}}已授权专长者决定审美，执行方不应再擅自加一道审美裁定；未授权就不能代作决定。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序，且有素材时加回。
title: Decide aesthetics only under explicit authority
text: {{决策者}} decides asset direction. If explicitly delegated, the authorized person specifies style and references consistently and retains authority and confirmation records, without mandatory aesthetic/execution/coordination roles. Makers follow confirmed requirements. Check file specifications, visibility, and usability in {{成品}} separately; technical self-checks are not aesthetic approval and aesthetic rework has no extra round cap.
rationale: Respect explicitly delegated aesthetic expertise without adding another aesthetic ruler; absent authority, do not decide on another's behalf.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts) and assets are involved.

短题: 小项目审美与规格分清
条文: 规模为小时，审美由{{决策者}}直接或明确授权1人确认，制作窗与助手不自改取向；约定先统一风格时先给样本确认再批量做。文件规格、是否看得清和能否用于{{成品}}另查，自查不能代替审美确认，审美返工不另设次数上限；不另增岗位或冻结流程。
为什么: 先定样，审美授权与规格分清，制作自检不冒充审美获批。
加回条件: 批量做≥1类素材时加回。
title: Separate small-project aesthetics and specifications
text: At small scale, {{决策者}} confirms aesthetics directly or explicitly delegates to one person; makers and helpers do not change direction. When common style is agreed first, confirm samples before bulk production. Check specifications, visibility, and usability in {{成品}} separately. Self-checking does not replace aesthetic approval; do not cap aesthetic rework or add roles or freeze procedures.
rationale: Confirm samples first and distinguish aesthetic authority from technical specifications; maker self-checking is not aesthetic approval.
restore_condition: Restore when producing at least one type of asset in bulk.

短题: 素材资源渐进按需加载
条文: 若运行时素材较多、一次全读会影响使用，就先加载眼前所需，再逐步或按需加载其余部分；不强制少量素材也采用同一种加载架构。
为什么: 先准备当前使用所需的素材，避免为加载全部资源造成卡顿。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码、素材时加回。
title: Load substantial runtime assets progressively
text: If many runtime assets would impair use when loaded together, load immediate needs first and the rest progressively or on demand. Do not impose the same architecture on small asset sets.
rationale: Prepare currently needed assets first to avoid stalls from loading everything.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code, assets.

短题: 负载先查代码不每单压测
条文: 负载要求先落代码，不给每单加常规压测。在线并发业务不用全局锁、整表锁或锁无关记录，高频周期不逐周期全表扫描、全量广播；交付说明新增锁范围、持久写入、扫描广播与阻塞读写，审计命中既定禁用写法即返工，不等压测。
为什么: 不能把负载治理变成每单压测负担；先约束可能扩大锁、写入、扫描和阻塞的代码写法，交付时据此自查。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码、上线时加回。
title: Address load in code, not routine stress tests
text: Implement load requirements in code without routine stress tests for every task. Concurrent online operations avoid global locks, full-table locks, and unrelated-record locks; frequent cycles avoid full-table scans and full broadcasts each cycle. At delivery describe new lock scopes, durable writes, scans, broadcasts, and blocking I/O. Audit established forbidden patterns immediately rather than waiting for stress tests.
rationale: Load governance should constrain costly locks, writes, scans, and blocking operations rather than burden every task with stress testing.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code, deployment.

短题: 主执行线程不做阻塞读写
条文: 交互主线程或周期处理线程中，不得进行同步阻塞的输入输出操作；发现即返工，不等负载测试。
为什么: 防止阻塞读写卡住交互或周期处理(源项目经验)
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Keep blocking I/O off main execution threads
text: Never perform synchronous blocking I/O on interactive main threads or periodic-processing threads. Return such code for repair immediately rather than waiting for load tests.
rationale: Prevent blocking I/O from stalling interaction or periodic processing, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 性能量测避开施工负载
条文: 性能量测放在相关改动全部合并后，同批集中量测一轮；量测期间不并行构建、测试、导入等干扰负载。非性能任务不据此一律停工。
为什么: 量测不能与构建、导入等负载互相干扰；资源避让只针对性能量测，不把其他取证也扩成全面停工。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Measure performance away from construction load
text: Measure performance in one concentrated round after relevant changes are merged. Do not run interfering builds, tests, or imports during measurement. Nonperformance tasks do not stop universally under this rule.
rationale: Measurement must not interfere with builds or imports; resource avoidance applies to actual performance measurement, not all evidence gathering.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 设备只按已定用途验收
条文: 若{{决策者}}已明确某台设备只用来查功能、不要求性能达标，则只保证{{成品}}在该设备上能打开、不崩溃并完成约定功能检查，不额外追加性能微调或对比测量；没有这项明确约定，就仍按本项目已定的功能和性能目标验收。
为什么: 若{{决策者}}已明确设备只承担功能检查，就不把未承诺的性能目标加回去；不能据此免除其他设备的既定目标。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥7 或分工位 ≥6 或（仓 ≥2 且上线 且分工位 ≥4），且有代码时加回。
title: Accept devices only for their agreed purpose
text: If {{决策者}} explicitly designates a device for functional checks without performance targets, ensure {{成品}} opens, does not crash, and completes agreed checks there. Do not add tuning or comparative measurement. Without that explicit arrangement, established functional and performance targets still apply.
rationale: A functional-only device does not regain unpromised performance requirements, but other devices retain their established targets.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=7, responsibility owners >=6, or repositories >=2 with deployment and responsibility owners >=4) and these features are enabled: code.

短题: 审查独立只读只报
条文: 若项目已设置审查席，其职责独立于生产指挥，只读生产件并向{{总协调}}报告，不直接指挥修改；各分工的意见经约定协调入口转达，审查者可互通事实。未设常设审查席时由现有负责人按任务组织独立检查，不因规模大就另增岗位。
为什么: 防止只读审查变成直接指挥生产(源项目经验)
加回条件: 决策者要设审查岗时加回
title: Keep review independent, read-only, and reporting-only
text: If a review role exists, it is independent of production command, reads production artifacts only, and reports to {{总协调}} without directing changes. Send role opinions through the agreed coordination entry; reviewers may exchange facts. Otherwise existing owners organize independent checks by task without adding a role merely because scale is large.
rationale: Prevent read-only review from turning into direct production command, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when the decision maker requests a review role.

短题: 审查只报挡活与可删项
条文: 已安排规矩或流程审查时，报告只列实际挡住工作的事项和可删除、合并的规矩流程，不借审查增加限制；未安排时不另建一套报表。
为什么: 审查应帮规矩做减法，而不是变成不断增加流程的来源。
加回条件: 决策者要设审查岗时加回
title: Review blockers and removable procedures only
text: When rule or process review is assigned, report actual blockers and rules or procedures that can be deleted or combined; do not add restrictions through review. Without such an assignment, do not create another report system.
rationale: Review should reduce rules rather than become a continuing source of additional process.
restore_condition: Restore when the decision maker requests a review role.

短题: 约定减法检查再集中处理
条文: 若已约定定期检查规矩，按约定频率集中列删除、合并、归档、续期或改成工具的建议，并附使用数字；{{决策者}}集中决定，{{总协调}}落实，优先处理协作者的减法建议。检查频率由本项目约定，不统一要求每周一次。
为什么: 集中处理删除、合并和续期，避免规矩只有新增入口，没有退出动作。
加回条件: 决策者要设审查岗时加回
title: Consolidate agreed rule-reduction reviews
text: If periodic rule review is agreed, collect deletion, combination, archival, renewal, or automation proposals at that frequency with usage figures. {{决策者}} decides centrally and {{总协调}} implements, prioritizing contributors' reduction suggestions. The project sets frequency; weekly review is not universal.
rationale: Consolidated removal, combination, and renewal keep rules from having only an entry path and no exit.
restore_condition: Restore when the decision maker requests a review role.

短题: 用返工与长等待检验减闸
条文: 若任务约定量化比较流程减量效果，就按同一记录周期统计返工数和等待他人超过1小时的次数；长等待减少时不能只因返工增加就判失败。指标反向变化应查具体流程，不仅凭两个数宣布成败；未约定不额外要求每日填表。
为什么: 允许先交付再改错时，要同时看返工和等待，避免只为压低返工数而增加等待。
加回条件: 决策者要设审查岗时加回
title: Evaluate fewer checks using rework and long waits
text: If a task agrees on quantitative process comparisons, count rework and waits for others longer than one hour over the same period. When long waits decrease, increased rework alone is not failure. Investigate specific processes when metrics move oppositely rather than declaring success or failure from two values. Do not add daily reports without agreement.
rationale: When delivery before correction is allowed, consider both rework and waiting rather than increasing waits solely to minimize rework.
restore_condition: Restore when the decision maker requests a review role.

短题: 按真实缺陷命中率留审计
条文: 若已约定评估独立检查是否有用，按约定周期记录检查次数、查到的真实缺陷及花费用时；裁减检查主要看真实缺陷命中率，不能只因花费高就取消。未设审查席可由现有负责人整理，不默认每个项目每周填表。
为什么: 查出真实缺陷的比例反映检查价值，不能把检查是否有用和花了多少混为一谈。
加回条件: 决策者要设审查岗时加回
title: Retain audits according to actual defect yield
text: If evaluating independent checking is agreed, record checks, real defects found, and time spent over the agreed period. Reduce checks primarily according to actual defect yield, not cost alone. Existing owners may compile results without a review role; do not default to weekly forms for every project.
rationale: The proportion of checks finding real defects indicates value, distinct from time or cost.
restore_condition: Restore when the decision maker requests a review role.

短题: 记录寿命只导出现行条
条文: 每条规矩记录生效日、到期日、替代关系和载体位置；生成阅读面只取生效未到期条，到期未续自动退出，被替代条转指继任，查询可追溯何时有效。
为什么: 保存依据还要区分当前有效、已到期与已替代内容。
加回条件: 决策者要建规矩库时加回
title: Export only currently effective rules
text: Record each rule's effective date, expiry, replacement relationship, and storage location. Generated reading material includes only effective unexpired rules. Unrenewed expired rules leave automatically; replaced rules point to successors, and queries retain when each was valid.
rationale: Preserved authorities must distinguish current, expired, and replaced content.
restore_condition: Restore when the decision maker requests a rule repository.

短题: 规矩引用关系可查询
条文: 记录各条规矩被哪些文书或分工位引用，保留可查询的引用关系。
为什么: 防止规矩变更时找不到引用方(源项目经验)
加回条件: 决策者要建规矩库时加回
title: Keep rule references queryable
text: Record which documents and roles reference each rule and retain queryable reference relationships.
rationale: Prevent rule changes from losing their consumers, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when the decision maker requests a rule repository.

短题: 人读导出与结构真源一致
条文: 采用结构化{{真源件}}时，定期导出可阅读、可比较差异的文本，供{{决策者}}与获授权的阅读方使用；文本与结构记录逐条一致，不另成一套内容。
为什么: 防止人读导出与结构真源各存一套(源项目经验)
加回条件: 决策者要建规矩库时加回
title: Keep readable exports aligned with structured authority
text: When using structured {{真源件}}, regularly export readable, diffable text for {{决策者}} and authorized readers. Align text with structured records item by item rather than creating another content set.
rationale: Prevent readable exports and structured authority from holding separate content, as observed in the source project.
restore_condition: Restore when the decision maker requests a rule repository.

短题: 版本仓内删除须可恢复
条文: 代码仓内的文件若已受完整版本历史保护，确认能从历史恢复时，可在本次任务授权内删除；不把这个例外用于没有版本保护的本地文件或永久删除。
为什么: 有可靠历史可恢复的仓内删除不等于永久丢失，但例外不能扩到普通文件。
加回条件: 维护≥1个代码仓时加回。
title: Allow recoverable repository deletion
text: Within current task authority, files protected by complete version history may be deleted after confirming recovery from history. Do not extend this exception to unversioned local files or permanent deletion.
rationale: Reliable version-history recovery differs from permanent loss, but that exception does not cover ordinary files.
restore_condition: Restore when maintaining at least one code repository.

短题: 说过通过的不再动
条文: {{决策者}}本人看过实物并明确说「通过」的成果不再动;要优化(含提速)先用人话说怎么改、用起来有什么不同,说了即可开工、不等点头;{{决策者}}说不要就停或回退,说变差了先找回认可版、以它为准。只改内部写法、不改外观与手感的不算动。
为什么: 认可过的效果被后来的优化悄悄改坏,找回比原活更费;先说一句给决策者拦的机会,又不必等审批。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Do not change an accepted result
text: Do not change a result that {{决策者}} personally inspected and explicitly accepted. For optimization, including performance, first explain in plain language what will change and how usage will differ; then start without waiting for approval. Stop or revert if {{决策者}} declines. If the result is worse, first recover the accepted version and use it as the reference. Internal rewrites that do not change appearance or feel do not count as changing the result.
rationale: Later optimizations can silently damage an accepted result and make recovery harder than the original work. Explaining first lets the decision maker object without requiring approval.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 原话照做不升规矩
条文: {{决策者}}在任一窗说的话,所在窗逐字记进原话件、在本窗职责内照做;不自行扩写成「以后 / 一律 / 先问」类规矩,也不通报全员。要成跨岗位规矩只两条路:{{决策者}}明说「这是规矩」或点名某窗逐字代写,否则交{{总协调}}落笔;岗位自写的规矩句无效,核出即删。
为什么: 一句当场指示被各窗各自扩写成规矩,规矩越叠越多、互相打架,最后分不清哪句是决策者真说过的。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Follow wording without creating rules
text: When {{决策者}} speaks in any window, that window records the wording verbatim and follows it within its responsibilities. Do not expand it into future, universal, or ask-first rules, or notify every role. A cross-role rule requires {{决策者}} to explicitly call it a rule or name a window to transcribe it verbatim; otherwise {{总协调}} writes it. Rules independently written by individual roles are invalid and must be removed when found.
rationale: When each window expands a local instruction into a rule, rules accumulate and conflict until the actual original decision becomes unclear.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 无事自行收窗
条文: 窗口无在办、无在途、无待答时自行收窗:在{{留痕处}}写一行「收窗」及下次开窗时机,不等{{决策者}}开口。
为什么: 空转的窗占资源,又要决策者逐个去喊收窗。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Close idle windows independently
text: A window with no active work, work in transit, or unanswered requests closes itself. Add one line to {{留痕处}} recording closure and the next reopening condition, without waiting for {{决策者}}.
rationale: Idle windows consume resources and otherwise require the decision maker to close each one.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 模型按固定格换名
条文: {{口径件}}按固定格(如顶级 / 甲 / 乙 / 丙 / 读件 / 审计)列可用模型,格名长期不变、只换格里的模型名;某模型额度用完时在{{留痕处}}写一行「<模型> 额度停 <时刻>」并换同格下一个,不问{{决策者}}、不改口径件。
为什么: 额度每天在变,每变一次都去问决策者或重排整张表,派遣就停下来等人。
加回条件: 派用≥2家模型时加回。
title: Replace models within fixed slots
text: List available models in {{口径件}} under fixed slots, such as top tier, A, B, C, reading, and audit. Keep slot names stable and replace only model names. When a model exhausts its quota, record “<model> quota stopped <time>” in {{留痕处}} and switch to the next model in the same slot without asking {{决策者}} or editing the policy file.
rationale: Daily quota changes must not halt dispatch while waiting for the decision maker or a complete reassignment table.
restore_condition: Restore when assigning work to at least two model providers.

短题: 爱堆防御的模型带精简句
条文: 派给已知爱堆防御代码、自加测试、过度封装的模型施工时,派单带一句:只写任务书要求的改动;能用现有函数就不新写;不加没要求的判空、重试、兜底分支、新封装层和新测试;外部输入只用原有校验。派这类模型审计时带一句:缺防御、缺兜底、可以更健壮不算缺陷,只报功能不对和真出错的地方。
为什么: 有的模型会把简单改动堆成大量防御代码和新测试,改动面变大、全量测试变红,主窗也被带偏。
加回条件: 开始写程序(代码)时加回。
title: Request concise work from overdefensive models
text: When assigning implementation to models known to add defensive code, unrequested tests, or excessive wrappers, include: make only the requested changes; reuse existing functions; add no unrequested null checks, retries, fallback branches, wrapper layers, or tests; use existing validation for external input. When assigning audits to these models, include: missing defensive handling, missing fallbacks, and potential robustness improvements are not defects; report only incorrect functionality and actual errors.
rationale: Some models turn small changes into extensive defensive code and extra tests, widening scope, breaking full test runs, and distracting the lead window.
restore_condition: Restore when programming (code) starts.

短题: 可开只答不干的咨询窗
条文: 需要时可开一扇咨询窗:带全部记忆、只读只答不干活,供{{决策者}}随时问现状、对齐需求;它不派单、不改件,答出的待办交给对应窗去做。
为什么: 决策者想随时问清全局,又不想打断正在干活的窗,或让它因为聊天改了手上的活。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序时加回。
title: Optional read-only consultation window
text: When useful, open a consultation window with all memory that only reads and answers, allowing {{决策者}} to ask about status and align requirements at any time. It assigns no work and edits no files; pass resulting tasks to their responsible windows.
rationale: The decision maker can understand the whole project without interrupting active windows or changing their work through conversation.
restore_condition: Restore when concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts.

短题: 两窗起步吃力再加
条文: 项目缺省只开两窗:{{总协调}}(需求窗)管规划、与{{决策者}}核对需求、拿「使用者打开能看见什么」对交付;技术主窗一位包全部技术——直派助手施工、自己合并、自派独立审计。出现吃力信号才加窗:技术窗等需求超过 1 小时成了常态,加需求对接窗;{{决策者}}亲测报回同类问题 ≥3 次,加测试窗;某类活的量大到技术窗做不完,加该类专窗。加出的窗连续一周没活就并回两窗。
为什么: 多数项目一个需求窗加一个技术主窗就能一口气做完;一开始按前端、后端、测试拆成多窗,交接和等待比活还多,层层加闸后反而做成决策者看不懂的东西。
加回条件: 写程序时加回。
title: Start with two windows; add only under strain
text: Projects default to only two windows: {{总协调}} (requirements window) handles planning, checks requirements with {{决策者}}, and evaluates delivery against what users can see when opening the result. One technical lead owns all technical work: directly assigns implementation helpers, merges their work, and assigns independent audits. Add windows only when strain signals appear: if the technical window routinely waits more than one hour for requirements, add a requirements-liaison window; if {{决策者}} reports the same kind of problem at least three times after personal testing, add a testing window; if a work category exceeds the technical window’s capacity, add a dedicated window for it. Merge added windows back to the two-window setup after a full week without work.
rationale: Most projects can be completed by one requirements window and one technical lead. Splitting frontend, backend, and testing into separate windows from the start adds more handoffs and waiting than work; layers of approval requirements can then produce something the decision maker cannot understand.
restore_condition: Restore when programming starts.

短题: 按功能切片一单到底
条文: 实现单按功能切片:一单从数据、逻辑、界面到测试由一人一口气交付,不按前后端分层拆;派单前先问一个人做不做得完,做得完就一张单一人到底。
为什么: 按层拆的单要互相等、对接口,各层都交了却拼不出一个能用的功能。
加回条件: 写程序时加回。
title: One owner delivers each feature slice
text: Split implementation assignments by feature. One person delivers data, logic, interface, and tests together instead of splitting frontend and backend layers. Before dispatch, ask whether one person can finish it; if so, keep one assignment with one owner throughout.
rationale: Layer-based assignments wait on each other and coordinate interfaces, yet may deliver every layer without producing a usable feature.
restore_condition: Restore when programming starts.

短题: 工期按 AI 工时估
条文: 估工期一律按 AI 工时:先按传统人类工时估出天数,再除以 15(例:150 天 → 10 天),写明换算;不拿人类工程量当理由劝退方案。
为什么: 按人类工时估,常把一天的活报成两周,好方案因「工程量太大」被放弃。
加回条件: 有≥1项任务时保留。
title: Estimate schedules in AI work time
text: Always estimate schedules in AI work time: first estimate traditional human-work days, divide by 15 (for example 150 days → 10 days), and state the conversion. Do not discourage a design on the basis of human engineering effort.
rationale: Human-work estimates can turn a day of work into a reported two weeks and cause good designs to be rejected for excessive effort.
restore_condition: Keep when there is at least one task.

短题: 上线只认决策者一句
条文: 正式上线只认{{决策者}}一句宣布;在此之前,外部平台上架、公开试玩都按开发期流程走,不因此自加闸口或审批。
为什么: 外部平台一上架就有人当成已上线,自己加闸加审批,开发节奏被拖慢。
加回条件: 同时窗 ≥4 或分工位 ≥2 或（仓 ≥2 且上线）或写程序，且有上线时加回。
title: Deployment requires the decision maker's announcement
text: Only an announcement from {{决策者}} counts as formal deployment. Before that, external platform listings and public playtests follow development procedures; do not introduce approval requirements or checks solely because of them.
rationale: Treating any external listing as deployed invites extra checks and approvals that delay development.
restore_condition: Restore when (concurrent windows >=4, responsibility owners >=2, repositories >=2 with deployment, or programming starts) and deployment is involved.
